Throw your rage and anger abroad, then look at anyone who is proud and humiliate them.
Look at whoever is proud and bring them down low, and walk the wicked back to their place.
Bury them in the dust, and imprison their faces in their secret grave.
Then I will also confess to you that your own right hand can save you.
Behold the large monstrous beasts that I made with you, he eats grass like an ox.
Look at the strength is in his waist, and the force in the navel of his stomach.
He moves his tail like a cedar tree, the sinews of his thighs are all wrapped together.
His bones are like iron bars and they are as strong as a piece of brass.
He is first in the ways of God, and his maker is the only one who can approach him with a sword.
Surely the mountains bring him food, where all the field animals play.
He lies under shady trees, sheltered by the reeds and ferns.
The shade trees cover him with their shadow, and the brook willows surround him.
Behold, he drinks from the river and does not hurry, he trusts that he can draw the Jordan river waters into his mouth.
He takes it all in with his eyes, and no one can pierce his nose with their snares.
And the Lord continued to answer Job and said, "Can you pull a leviathan from the water with just a hook, or can you tie his tongue with a cord?
Can you put a hook in his nose, or bore through his jaw with a thorn?
Will he make many pleas to you? Will he speak softly to you?
Will he make a covenant with you to be your servant forever?
Will you play with him like with a bird, or will you put a leash on him for your young women?
Will your companions make a banquet of him, and divide him up among the merchants?
Can you fill his skin with barbed harpoons, or pierce his head with fishing spears?
If you Laid your hand on him and remembered the battle, you would never do that again.
Behold, it is vain for you to think or hope that he you can capture him. Anyone who tries will just give up at the sight of him?
Nobody is fierce enough or has the courage to stir him up, so then who is able to stand before me?
Who has prevented me or made me repay him? Because everything under the whole heaven is mine.
I will not conceal the leviathans, nor his power or graceful proportions.
Who can strip the skin off of his face, or approach him with a double bridle?
Who can open his jaws and expose his terrible teeth.
He is proud of his scales, and they are closed shut and sealed.
They are so close together, that no air can come between them.
They are joined together and they cannot be split apart.
His sneezes blast like shining light, and his eyes are like morning eyelids.
Burning lamps come from his mouth, and sparks of fire leap out.
Smoke comes from his nostrils like steam from a boiling pot or caldron.
His breath kindles coals, and flames shoot out of his mouth.
His neck remains strong, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
The flakes of his flesh are joined together, they are firm and cannot be moved.
His heart is as firm as stone, and yes it as hard as a piece of the lower millstone.
When the leviathan raises up, the mighty are afraid and they retreat to purify themselves.
Any sword that reaches him cannot hurt him, neither can the spear, dart, or arrow.
He looks at iron as if it were straw, and regards brass as rotten wood.
The arrow cannot make him flee, slingstones are like straw to him.
Darts are counted as straw, he laughs at the shaking spear.
His undersides are like sharp stones, his sharp pointed fins spreads the mud across the bottom.
He makes the deep waters boil like a pot, and he churns the sea like a pot of ointment.
He makes the wake behind him shine, one would think the deep had grayish white hair.
There are no others on earth made without fear, like him.
He sees all the higher things, and he is king over all the proud."
Then Job answered the Lord.
And he said, "I know that you can do everything, and that no thoughts can be withheld from you.
You asked, 'Who is this that hides my counsel without knowledge?' So I spoke of things too wonderful for me to understand, things which I knew nothing about.
And you said, 'I will demand an answer from you, and you will answer me.'
I have heard of you before, but now my eyes see you.
So I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes."

After the Lord had spoken Job, the Lord spoke to Eliphaz the Temanite and said, "My anger is kindled against you and your two friends, because you have not spoken the truth about the way that my servant Job has.

So now I want you to take seven bulls and seven rams to my servant Job, and offer up burnt offerings for yourselves and my servant Job will pray for you. Because I will accept his prayers and not deal with you for your foolishness. Because you have not spoken righteously of me like my servant Job."
So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite did everything that the Lord had commanded them to do, and the Lord accepted Job's prayer.
After Job prayed for his friends, the Lord restored his prosperity, and gave him twice as much as he had before.

Then all of Job's brothers, sisters, and former acquaintances came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They all mourned him and comforted him for all the evil that the Lord had brought on him, and they each also gave him some money and a gold earring.
So the Lord blessed the latter part of Job's life even more than his beginning, because he had 14,000 sheep, 6,000 camels, 1,000 yoke of oxen, and 1,000 female donkeys.
He had also seven sons and three daughters.
The first one was named Jemima, the second was named Kezia, and third was named Keren-Happuch.
And there were no women as beautiful as Job's daughters found throughout the land, and their father gave them an inheritance along with their brothers.
Job lived for 140 years after all this, and he saw his children and grandchildren grow up to four generations.
So Job was old and full of days when he died.
Blessed is the man who does not travel in the company of the ungodly, or follow the path of sinners, or sit with the mockers.
But he delights in the Law of the Lord, and he meditates on his law day and night.
He will be like a tree planted by the rivers, that brings out good fruit in season, its leaves will not wither, and whatever he does will prosper.
The ungodly are not like this, they are like straw that blows away in the wind.
So the ungodly will not withstand the judgment, nor will sinners be in the assembly of the righteous.
For the Lord knows the ways of the righteous, but the ways of the ungodly will perish.
Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
The kings of the earth and the world rulers conspire together against the Lord and his anointed one.
And they said, "Let's tear their groups apart and throw away their cords that bind us.
The one who sits in heaven will laugh, and the Lord will mock them.
Then he will speak to them in his anger, and frustrate them with his intense indignation.
And he said, "But, I have set my king high on Mount Zion."
I will declare the decree given to me by the Lord who said, "You are my son, and today I have become your father.
Ask me, and I will give the heathen to you as your inheritance, and the furthest parts of the earth as your possession.
You will break them with an iron staff, and dash them into pieces like a potter's bowl.
So now, O you kings and judges of the earth be wise and take his instructions.
Serve the Lord with fear and rejoice with trembling.
Kiss the son, or else when his anger is kindled he will be angry and you will perish because of your ways. Blessed is anyone who puts their trust in the Lord.
Lord, my enemies have increased and trouble me! How many of them there are that rise up against me.
Many of them say of my soul, "here is no help for him in God." Praise the Lord!
But you O Lord, are my shield, my glory, and you lift my head up.
I cried out to the Lord, and he heard me from his holy hill. Praise the Lord!
I laid down and went to sleep, and I awakened because the Lord sustained me.
I will not be afraid of the tens of thousands who are against me.
O my Lord God, rise up and save me, because you have struck all my enemies on the cheek, and you have broken the ungodly's teeth.
Salvation belongs to the Lord, your blessing is on your people. Praise the Lord!
O my righteous God, hear me when I call because you enlarged me when I was in distress. Have mercy on me and hear my prayer.
O you sons of men, how long will you turn my glory into shame? How long will you love vanity and seek out lies? Praise the Lord!
But know this, the Lord has set the Godly apart for himself, and he will hear me when I call out to him.
Stand in awe of God and do not sin, be still and pray on your own bed and speak from the heart. Praise the Lord!
Offer the righteous sacrifices and trust in the Lord.
There are many who say, "Who can show us anything good?" Lord, lift up and shine the light of your face upon us.
You have put happiness in my heart, even more so, than when their wheat and wine were in abundance.
Now I lay me down to sleep, because only you O Lord, make me live in safety.
O Lord, listen to my words and consider my meditation.
O my king and God, listen to my crying voice because I will pray to you.
O Lord, I will direct my prayers to you and you will hear my voice in the morning, and I will look up to you.
Because you are not a God that takes pleasure in wickedness, nor will evil live within you.
The foolish will not stand in your sight, and you hate all workers of immorality.
You will destroy all those who speak lies, and the Lord will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
But as for me, I will enter your house in the abundance of your mercy. I will fear you and worship you toward your Holy temple.
O Lord, lead me with your righteousness because of my enemies and make your way straight before me.
Because there is no faithfulness in their mouths and they are very wicked inside. Their throat is an open tomb and they flatter with their tongue.
O God, destroy you them and let them fall by their own decisions. They have rebelled against you, so throw them out because of their abundant transgressions.
But let everyone who puts their trust in you rejoice, let them forever shout for joy, because you defend them, and let those who love your name be joyful in you.
For you, Lord, will bless the righteous, and surround them with favor as if it were a shield.
O Lord, do not reprimand in your anger, nor chasten me in your hot displeasure.
O Lord, have mercy on me because I am weak. O Lord, heal me because my bones are weak.
My soul is terribly frustrated, so now how long, O Lord, how long must I endure?
O Lord, return and deliver my soul, oh save me for your mercies' sake.
Because in death there is no one to remember you, and in the grave who will give thanks to you?
I am weary from groaning, my tears make me swim in my bed all night and they drench my couch.
My eyes are consumed by grief, and they grow old because of all my enemies.
Now, all you workers of immorality must leave me, because the Lord has heard my weeping.
The Lord has heard my plea and he will receive my prayer.
Let all my enemies be ashamed and disturbed, let them suddenly turn away with shame.
O my Lord God, I put my trust in you, save me from anyone who persecutes me, and deliver me.
Or else they will tear my soul into pieces like a lion, when there is no one to deliver me.
O my Lord God, if I have done this or immorality has come from my hands.
If I have rewarded evil to anyone who was at peace with me, or I have delivered anyone to my enemy without cause.
Let the enemy persecute and take my soul, let him trample down my life on earth, and leave my honor in the dust. Praise the Lord!
Rise up in anger and rage at my enemies O Lord, lift yourself up and awaken the judgment which you have commanded for me.
So that the people will surround you, and for their sakes return to your seat way up on high.
The Lord will judge the people, O Lord judge me in accordance with the integrity and righteousness within me.
Oh put an end to the wickedness of the wicked, but establish the just, because God tries the hearts and minds of the righteous.
My defense is from God, who saves those with an honest heart.
God judges the righteous and he is angry with the wicked every day.
If he does not repent, God will sharpen his sword, his bow is bent and made ready.
He has also prepared the instruments of death for him, he ordained his arrows against the persecutors.
Behold, he labors with immorality, conceives mischief, and brings lies.
He dug a pit, and it has fallen into the ditch which he made.
His mischief returns to him, and his violent dealings fall on his own head.
I will praise the Lord's righteousness, and sing praises to the name of the Lord most high.
O our Lord God, how excellent is your name on all the earth! You, who have set your glory above the heavens.
From the mouth of babes and infants, your strength has been ordained because of your enemies, so that you can silence the enemy and the avenger.
When I consider your heavens and the work of your fingers, and I have seen the moon and the stars which you have ordained.
What is it about a man that makes you think of him, and what is it about the Son of Man that makes you visit him?
Because you have made him a little lower than the angels, and you have crowned him with glory and honor.
You gave him authority over the works of your hands, and you put all things under his feet.
Over all the sheep, oxen, and the other field animals.
The birds of the air, fish of the sea, and whatever else passes through the waves of the oceans.
O Lord our Lord, how excellent is your name on all the earth!
O Lord, I will praise you with my whole heart, and I will reveal all your marvelous works.
O you most high, I will be glad and rejoice in you and sing praises to your name.
When my enemies turn back, they will fall and perish in your presence.
Because you maintained my cause and righteousness, and you sat on the throne judging righteously.
You reprimanded the heathen, you destroyed the wicked, and you have erased their name forever and ever.
The enemy has come to a never ending destruction, you have destroyed their cities, and the memory of them has perished.
But the Lord will endure forever, he has prepared his throne for judgment.
He will judge the world in righteousness, and he ministers honest judgment to the people.
The Lord will also be a place of refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
Lord, those who know your name will put their trust in you, because you have not forsaken them.
Sing praises to the Lord who lives in Zion, and declare his deeds to the people.
When he inquires about bloodshed, he remembers and he does not forget the cries of the humble.
O Lord, have mercy on me and consider the troubles I have suffered from those who hate me. Lift me up and deliver me from the gates of death.
So that I can reveal all your praises within the gates of Jerusalem the Daughter of Zion, I will rejoice in your salvation.
The heathen have sunk down into the pit that they dug, their own feet have been caught in the net which they had hidden.
The Lord is known by his judgments, the wicked are caught in a snare of their own making. Meditate, and praise the Lord!
The wicked are returned to the hell of all nations that forget God.
Because the needy will not always be forgotten, and the hope of the poor will not perish forever.
O Lord, rise up and do not let man prevail, let the heathen be judged in your sight.
O Lord, put fear them in, so that the nations may know they are but mere men. Praise the Lord!
O Lord, why do you stand so far away? Why do you hide in times of trouble?
The proud and wicked persecute the poor, let them be captured by their own devices which they have imagined.
Because the wicked boast of their heart's desire, and bless the covetous, whom the Lord abhors.
The wicked, through the pride of his appearance does not seek God, God is not in all his thoughts.
His ways are always grievous, your judgments are far above his ability to understand, and he scoffs at all his enemies.
In his heart he says , "I will not be moved, because I never suffer adversity."
His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and fraud. He utters mischief and vanity under his tongue.
He lurks in secret places in the villages where he murders the innocent, and he privately searches for opportunities to attack the poor.
He secretly lies in wait like a lion in his den, he lies in wait to catch the poor, when he catches the poor, he draws them into his net.
He crouches and humbles himself, so that the poor fall prey to his strength.
In his heart he has said, "God has forgotten, he hides his face and he never sees what I have done."
O Lord God, rise up and lift your hand, and do not forget the humble.
So why do the wicked hold God in contempt? He has said in his heart, "You will never hold me accountable for my actions."
You have seen it, because you have seen their mischief and spite. You will avenge it with your hand, and the poor commit themselves to you because you help the fatherless.
Break the evil and wicked man's arm, search through his wickedness until you find none left.
The Lord is king forever and ever, and the heathen perish and disappear from his land.
O Lord, you have heard the desires of the humble and you prepare their heart, and you hear their prayers.
To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, so that the earthly man, may no longer oppress them.
I put my trust in the Lord, so how does he say to my soul, "Flee and fly like a bird into the mountains.
Because the wicked are ready to secretly shoot at the honest at heart, they bend their bows and string their arrows.
And if the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do anyway?"
The Lord is on his throne in his holy temple in heaven, his eyes behold everything and he tries the children of men.
The Lord tries the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and anyone who loves violence.
He will rain down snares and fire and brimstone on the wicked, and horrible violent storms will be their portion.
Because the righteous Lord loves righteousness, his appearance beholds the honest.
Lord help us, because there are no Godly men and the faithful children of men fail.
They vainly lie to their neighbors, and with flattery they speak from a double heart.
The Lord will cut off all flattery and anyone who speaks of proud things.
And those who have said, "We will prevail with lies, we can say whatever we want, and who can be our Lord?"
So now the Lord says, "Now I will rise up because of the oppression of the poor, and the sighs of the needy. And I will move him to safety away from anyone who scoffs at him."
The Lord's words are pure words, as pure as silver refined in a brick furnace and purified seven times over.
O Lord, you will keep them and preserve this generation forever.
The wicked walk on every side and the vilest of men are glorified.
O Lord, how long will you forget me? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long must I take daily counsel in my soul with sorrow in my heart? How long will my enemy be glorified over me?
O Lord my God consider me, hear me and enlighten my soul, or I will sleep the sleep of death.
Or else my enemies will say, "I have prevailed against him!" And those who trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
But I have trusted in your mercy and my heart will rejoice in your salvation.
I will sing to the Lord, because he has dealt bountifully with me.
The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, and they have done abominable things, and none of them do good things.
The Lord looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, and looked for God.
But, they were all gone and all of them had become filthy, there was not even one who did good things.
Do all the workers of immorality have no knowledge? They devoured my people as if they were bread, and they refused to call on the Lord.
There they are in great fear, because God is in the generation of the righteous.
You have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his refuge.
Oh if only the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the Lord brings back of his captive people, Jacob will rejoice and Israel will be glad!
Lord, who can endure in your tabernacle, and who can live on your holy hill?
The one that walks in honesty, works righteousness, and speaks the truth from his heart.
The one who does not backbite with his tongue, who does not slander or commit evil against his neighbor.
The one who views a vile person with contempt, but honors those that fear the Lord. The one who swears the truth to his own disadvantage, and can not be changed.
The one who does not loan his money to usury, nor takes a reward against the innocent. And the one who does these things will never be moved.
O God, preserve me because I put my trust in you.
My soul spoke to the Lord and said, "You are my Lord, without you I have nothing good."
But the saints of the earth, is where the excellence lives to delight my heart.
But those who chase after other gods will find their sorrows multiplied, and I will not offer their blood drink offering, nor will I speak their names from my lips.
The Lord is my cup and my portion of my inheritance, you maintain my lot.
The lines of my boundaries have fallen in pleasant places, and I have a good heritage.
I bless the Lord, who has given me good counsel and my conscience instructs me in the middle of the night.
I always put the Lord before me, because he is at my right hand and I will not be moved.
So my heart is glad and my glory rejoices, my flesh will also rest in hope.
Because you will not leave my soul in hell, nor will you let your Holy One see decay.
You will show me the path to life, you will fill me with joy in your presence, and there are eternal pleasures at your right hand.
O Lord, hear the righteous, pay attention to my cries and listen to my sincere prayers.
Let my words come from your presence, may your eyes see all righteous things.
You have tested my heart and visited me in the night, you have tried me and found no evil, I am determined that my mouth will not sin.
As for the works of men, through the words of your lips I have avoided the paths of the violent.
I have followed your paths, so that my foot does not slip.
O God, I have called on you because you hear me, please listen to me and hear what I say.
O you Lord, who saves with your right hand, show your marvelous loving kindness to those who put their trust in you, and protect them from those who rise up against them.
Keep me like the apple of your eye, hide me under the shadow of your wings.
Protect me from the wicked who oppress me, and my deadly enemies who have surrounded me.
They are trapped in their own fat, and they speak proudly with their mouth.
They tracked us down and they surround us, they have their eyes set on forcing us to bow face down to the ground.
They are like a greedy lion stalking his prey, or like they were a young lion lurking in secret places.
Rise up O Lord, and disappoint him, throw him down and deliver my soul from the wicked with your sword.

O Lord, save me from the worldly men with your hand, worldly men who have saved their entire portion in this life. Fill your righteous ones and their children with your hidden treasure, so that they may leave their grandchildren an abundant inheritance.
As for me, I will behold your face in righteousness, and I will be satisfied when I am awakened by your likeness.
O Lord, you are my strength and I love you.
The Lord is my God, my rock, my fortress, my deliverer, my strength, my shield, my high tower, and the horn of my salvation in whom I will trust.
I will call on the Lord, who is worthy to be praised, so that I will be saved from my enemies.
The sorrows of death surrounded me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
The sorrows of hell surrounded me, and the snares of death confronted me.
In my distress I called on the Lord and cried out to my God, he heard my voice from his temple, and he heard my cries that came before him.
Then the earth shook and trembled, the foundations of the hills also moved and were shaken because he was angry.
Smoke billowed from his nostrils, and a devouring fire came from his mouth, and coals were kindled by it.
He also opened the heavens and came down with darkness under his feet.
And he was riding on a cherub and he flew on the wings of the wind.
He made the darkness his secret place, all around him was his canopy of dark waters with skies filled with thick clouds.
His flashing lightening and the thick clouds passed before him, as hail and burning coals fell from the sky.
The highest Lord's voice thundered in the heavens, the sound of hail stones and burning coals were heard by his enemies.
Yes, he scattered his arrows and shot them out like bolts of lightning, and embarrassed them.
O Lord, then the rushing waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered when you reprimanded them, with a blast from your nostrils.
He reached down from above, and took hold of me and he drew me out from many different waters.
He rescued me from my powerful enemies and from those who hated me, because they were too strong for me.
They confronted me on the day of my disaster, but the Lord was my savior.
He brought me out into a large open place, he delivered me because he was delighted in me.
The Lord rewarded me in accordance with my righteousness, and he has rewarded me equal with the cleanliness of my hands.
Because I have kept the Lord's ways, and I have not wickedly abandoned my God.
Because all his judgments are before me, and I have not ignored his laws.
I was also honest before him, and I have always avoided my immorality.
So the Lord has rewarded me as my righteousness justified, and according to the cleanliness of my hands in his sight.
My Lord God, you show mercy to the merciful, and you are honest with an honest man.
Lord, you are pure with the pure and you are stubborn with the stubborn.
Because you save the afflicted people, but you humble the high and mighty.
For you are my lord God who lights my candle and enlightens my darkness.
Because with you God I have run through troops, and with my God's help I have leaped over walls.
As for God, his ways are perfect, the word of the Lord is tried and true, and he is a shield for anyone who trusts in him.
For who is God except the Lord, or who is a rock except our God?
It is God who clothes me with strength, and makes my way perfect.
He makes my feet like the does' feet, and sets me in my high places.
He teaches war to my hands, so that a steel bow is broken by my arms.
You have also given me your shield of salvation, your right hand has held me up, and your gentleness has made me great.
You have enlarged my path, so that my feet can not slip.
I have pursued and overtaken my enemies, and I did not retreat until they were consumed.
I wounded them and they were unable to rise, they have fallen under my feet.
For you have endowed me with strength to do battle, and you have subdued my enemies beneath me.
You have put the necks of my enemies under my foot, so that I could destroy those who hate me.
They cried out, but there was no one to save them, they even cried out to the Lord, but he did not answer them.
Then I beat them down like dust in the wind, and I threw them out like dirt in the streets.
You have delivered me from the people's strife, and you have made me the head of the heathen and people I do not know serve me.
As soon as strangers hear of me, they obey and submit themselves to me.
Strangers will fade away, and they will be afraid to leave their close places.
The Lord lives and he is my blessed rock, and let the God of my salvation be glorified.
It is God that avenges me, and subdues the people under me.
He delivers me from my enemies, you lift me up above those who rise up against me, and you have delivered me from violent men.
O Lord, that's why I will give thanks to you among the heathen, and sing praises to your name.
God gives great deliverance to his king, and the Lord shows mercy to his anointed David and his descendants forever.
The heavens declare God's glory, and the skies displays his handywork.
Day after day he speaks, and night after night displays his knowledge.
There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
Their voice has gone throughout the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them he has established a tabernacle for the sun.
Which is like a bridegroom coming from his room, and rejoices like a strong man running a race.
He rises from one end of the heaven, and traverses the sky until to the end, and nothing escapes its heat.
The Lord's Law is perfect, the Lord's testimony is sure and converts the soul, making the wise simple.
The laws of the Lord are righteous, they rejoice the heart, the Lord's commandment is pure and it enlightens the eyes.
Fear of the Lord is clean and it endures forever, the Lord's judgments are altogether true and righteous.
The Lord's judgements are more desirable than fine gold, yes they are also sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.
Besides that, your servant is warned by them, and great rewards come by keeping them.
Who can understand his errors? Dear Lord, please cleanse me of secret faults.
Protect your servant from overconfident sins; do not let them have authority over me. Then I will be honest and innocent from the great transgression.
Let the words of my mouth and my heart's meditation be acceptable in your sight. O Lord, you are my strength and my rescuer.
Let the Lord hear you on the day of trouble, may the name of Jacob's God defend you.
May he send help to you from the sanctuary and strengthen you from Zion.
May the Lord remember and accept all your offerings and burnt sacrifices. Praise the Lord!
May the Lord grant you everything your heart desires, and may he make everything you do successful.
We will rejoice in your salvation and raise our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord satisfy all of your petitions.
Now I know that the Lord saves his anointed ones, he hears them from his holy heaven and responds with the saving strength of his right hand.
Some trust in chariots and some trust in horses, but we will remember the name of our Lord God.
They have fallen and are brought down, but we rise and stand in honesty.
O Lord, save the king and hear us when we call.
O Lord, the king will find joy in your strength and he will greatly rejoice in your salvation!
You have given him his heart's desire and you have not withheld his requests. Praise the Lord!
Because you preceded him with good blessings and you have set a crown of pure gold on his head.
He asked you for life Lord, and you gave him long days lasting forever and ever.
His glory is great in your salvation and you have given him honor and majesty.
Because you have made him the most blessed forever, you have made him exceedingly happy with the expression on your face.
Because the king trusts the Lord, and through the mercy of the most high God he will not be moved.
Your hand will find all of your enemies and your right hand will find those who hate you.
You Lord, will make them like a fiery oven in the time of your anger; your anger will swallow them up, and they will be devoured by fire.
You will destroy their fruit from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
Because they intended to harm you, but their imagined mischievous devices will not prevail.
So you will make them retreat when your bow is strung with arrows against them.
O Lord, be glorified in your own strength, so we can sing and praise your power.
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far away from helping me and so far away from my groanings?
O my God, I cry out in the day time, but you do not hear, and I am not silent at night.
But you are holy and you live in the praises of Israel.
Our fathers trusted you, they trusted and you delivered them.
They cried out to you and they were delivered, they trusted you and they were not confused.
But I am a worm and not a man, I am disapproved of by men and despised by the people.
Anyone who sees me laughs and mocks me, they sneer and shake their heads.
And they said, "He trusted the Lord so that he would deliver him, let the Lord deliver him, since he delights in him."
But you are the one who took me from the womb, you made me hope when my mother held me in her breasts.
I was throw on you from the womb, you have been my God since I came from my mother's stomach.
Do not go far from me, because trouble is near and there is no one to help.
Many bulls have surrounded me, strong Bashan bulls have encircled me.
Their mouths gaped wide open at me like a ravenous roaring lion.
I have been poured out like water, all my bones are out of joint, my heart growls as it melts in the middle of my bowels.
My strength has dried up like a potsherd, my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth and you have brought me down into the dust of death.
Because dogs have surrounded me, the assembly of the wicked have encircled me and they pierce my hands and feet.
I can see all my bones, they look and stare at me.
They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothes.
But O Lord, do not be far from me because my strength and help comes from you.
Deliver my soul from the sword, and my darling from the power of the dog.
Save me from the lion's mouth, because you have heard me from the horns of the wild oxen.
I will declare your name to my brothers and I will praise you in the middle of the congregation.
All you who fear the Lord, praise him, and all you descendants of Jacob and Israel, glorify and fear him.
Because the Lord did not despise nor abhor the suffering of the afflicted, nor did he hide his face from them. But the Lord heard them when they cried out to him.
I will praise you in the great congregation, and I will pay what I promised before those who fear him.
They will praise the Lord who seeks them, the meek will eat and be satisfied and may their heart live forever.
Everyone all the way to ends of the world will remember and turn to the Lord, and all the relatives of the nations will worship before you.
Because the kingdom belongs to the Lord, and he is the governor among the nations.
Everyone that is fat on the earth will eat and worship, everyone that goes down to the dust will bow before him, and no one can keep their own soul alive.
Posterity will serve him, and it will teach the Lord's message to a new generation.
They will come and declare his righteousness and everything he has done to a people yet to be born.
The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want.
He makes me lie down in green pastures and he leads me beside still waters.
He restores my soul, he leads me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil because you are with me, your rod and your staff comfort me.
You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies, you anoint my head with oil, my cup is overflowing.
Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will live in the Lord's house forever.
The earth belongs to the Lord, including the world's fullness and everyone that lives there.
Because he has built it on the seas and established it upon the waters.
Who will ascend the Lord's hill or stand in his holy place?
He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who has not lifted up his soul to vanity nor sworn deceitfully.
He will receive the Lord's blessing and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
This is the generation of those who seek him and seek your face, O Jacob. Praise the Lord!
Lift up your heads, O gates. Let the everlasting doors be lifted up and the king of glory will enter.
Who is this king of glory? It is the strong and mighty Lord, the Lord who is mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, O gates. Let the everlasting doors be lifted up and the king of glory will enter.
Who is this king of glory? The Lord of Hosts is the king of glory. Praise the Lord!
O Lord, I lift up my soul to you.
O my God, I trust in you, do not let me be ashamed and do not let my enemies triumph over me.
Let no one who waits on the Lord be ashamed, but let those who transgress without cause be ashamed.
O Lord, show me your ways and teach me your paths.
Lead me and teach me in your truth, because you are the God of my salvation on whom I wait all day.
O Lord, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindnesses, because they are ancient and they last forever.
O Lord, please do not remember the sins of my youth nor my transgressions, but remember me with mercy for your goodness' sake.
The Lord is good and honest, so he will teach sinners his ways.
He will guide the meek with his judgment and he will teach them his ways.
All of the Lord paths are mercy and truth for those who keep his covenant and testimonies.
O Lord, for your name's sake, pardon my immorality because it is great.
What kind of man fears the Lord? The Lord will teach him the ways that he chooses.
His soul will live at ease, and his descendants will inherit the earth.
The Lord's secret is with those who fear him, and he will show them his covenant.
My eyes are forever focused on the Lord, because he will pluck my feet from the net.
O Lord, turn to me and have mercy on me, because I am desolate and afflicted.
O Lord, my heart's troubles are enlarged, bring me out of my distresses.
Look at my pain and affliction and forgive all my sins.
Consider my many enemies who hate me with cruel hatred.
O keep and deliver my soul, do not let me be ashamed because I put my trust in you.
Let integrity and honesty preserve me because I wait on you.
O God, rescue Israel from all of his troubles.
O Lord, judge me because I have walked in my integrity, I have trusted in the Lord and that's why I will not slip.
O Lord, examine, test, and prove my heart, soul, and mind.
Because your loving kindness is before me, and I have walked in your truth.
I have not sat with vain people, nor will I spend time with hypocrites.
I hate the congregation of evildoers and I will not sit with the wicked.
O Lord, I will wash my hands in innocence, so that I can be near your altar.
That way, I can publicly speak of thanksgiving and tell everyone of all your wonderous works.
O Lord, I have loved the home of your house where your honor lives.
Do not assemble my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men.
Or those whose hands create mischief and their right hand is full of bribes.
But as for me, I will walk in my integrity, so rescue me and be merciful to me.
My foot stands on level ground and I will bless the Lord in the congregations.
The Lord is my light and salvation, so who will I fear? The Lord is my life's strength, so who will I be afraid of?
When the wicked and my enemies came to eat my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
Even if an army bivouacs against me, my heart will not fear, and if war should rise up against me, I will be confident in the Lord.
One thing have I sought and desired from the Lord, is that I may live in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the Lord's beauty and ask of him in his temple.
For in the time of trouble he will hide me in the secret of his tabernacle within his pavilion, and he will set me upon a rock.
And now my head will be lifted up above my enemies who surround me, and that's why I will offer joyous sacrifices to him in his tabernacle. And yes, I will sing praises to the Lord.
O Lord, hear me when I cry out with my voice and have mercy on me when you answer.
When you said, "Seek my face," and my heart answered you and said, "Lord, I will seek your face."
Do not hide your face far from me and do not dismiss your servant in anger. O God of my salvation, you have been my help, please do not leave me nor forsake me.
After my father and mother have forsaken me, the Lord will take me up.
O Lord, teach me your ways and lead me along the plain path, because of my enemies.
Do not deliver me over to the will of my enemies, because the kind of false witnesses that breathe out violence and cruelty have risen up against me.
I would have fainted, if I had not believed that I would see the Lord's goodness in the land of the living.
Wait on the Lord, be courageous and he will strengthen your heart. Again I say, wait on the Lord.
O Lord, you are my rock and I will cry out to you, do not be silent to me, because if you are silent to me, I will become like those who go down into the pit.
O Lord, hear my pleas when I cry out to you, and when I lift my hands up toward your holy inner sanctuary.
Do not draw me away with the wicked and the workers of immorality, who speak peace to their neighbors with mischief in their hearts.
Give to them what their deeds and wicked endeavors have earned, give them what is justified by the works of their hands, and give them their just rewards.
Because they do not regard the Lord's works nor the operation of his hands, he will destroy them and he will not build them up.
Blessed is the Lord because he has heard the voice of my pleas.
The Lord is my strength and my shield, my heart trusted in him and I am helped. That's why my heart greatly rejoices, and I will praise him with my song.
The Lord is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
Save your people and bless your inheritance, please feed them and lift them up forever.
O you mighty ones, give to the Lord, give strength and glory to the Lord.
Give the glory to the Lord that is due to his name, worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
The Lord's voice is over the waters, the glory of God thunders and the Lord covers many waters.
The Lord's voice is powerful and full of majesty.
The Lord's voice breaks the cedars, yes he breaks the cedars of Lebanon.
He also makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Mount Hermon like a young wild ox.
The Lord's voice divided with flames of fire.
The Lord's voice shakes the wilderness and the wilderness of Kadesh.
The Lord's voice makes the wild does calve, and it discovers the forests. And everyone in his temple speaks of his glory.
The Lord sits over the flood, and yes the Lord sits as king forever.
The Lord will give strength to his people, and he will bless his people with peace.
O Lord, I will exalt you because you have lifted me up, and you did not let my enemies rejoice over me.
O my Lord God, I cried out to you and you healed me.
O Lord, you brought my soul up from the grave and you kept me alive, so that I would not have to go down to the pit.
O you who are his saints, sing to the Lord and give thanks in memory of his holiness.
Because his anger only lasts for a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime, weeping may endure during night, but joy comes in the morning.
And in my prosperity I said, "I will never be moved."
O Lord, by your grace you made my mountain stand strong, but when you hid your face from me, I was troubled.
O Lord, I cried out and made a plea to you.
What will my blood profit you if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it declare your truth?
O Lord, hear me and have mercy on me, and please be my helper.
You have turned my grief and mourning into dancing, you have removed my sackcloth and covered me with happiness.
O my Lord God, my glory will sing praises to you to the very end. I will not be silent and I will give thanks to you forever.
O Lord, I put my trust in you, never let me be ashamed and deliver me into your righteousness.
Hear me and quickly deliver me and save me, you are my strong defensive rock.
Because you are my rock and my fortress, so for your name's sake lead me and guide me.
Pull me out of the net that they have laid privately for me, because you are my strength.
O Lord God of truth, I commit my spirit into your hand because you have rescued me.
I have hated those who respect lying vanities, but I trust in the Lord.
I will be glad and rejoice in your mercy because you have seen my troubles, you have known my soul's adversities.
You did not shut me up in my enemies hand, you have set me free in a large open room.
O Lord, have mercy on me because I am in trouble, and yes my eyes, soul, and stomach have been consumed with grief.
Because my life has been consumed with grief and my years with sighing; my strength fails because of my immorality, and my bones have been consumed.
All my enemies disapprove of me, but my neighbors especially disapprove of me. They are afraid to make my acquaintance, and whenever they see me they flee away from me.
I am as forgotten and out of mind as a dead man, I am like a broken bowl.
Because I have heard the slander of many. I was in fear everywhere I turned while they conspired against me, and devised ways to take my life.
But O Lord, I trusted in you and said, "You are my God!"
My time is in your hand, deliver me from my enemy's hand and from those who persecute me.
Make your face shine on your servant and save me for your mercies' sake.
O Lord, do not let me be ashamed because I have called on you. Let the wicked be ashamed and silence them in the grave.
Let their lying lips be silenced, especially those who speak grievously proud and contemptuous things against the righteous.
How great is your goodness which you have stored up for those who fear you, which you have given to those who trust in you before the sons of men!
You must hide them in your secret presence from the pride of man, and you will keep them in a secret pavilion away from the conflict of tongues.
Blessed be the Lord, because he has shown me his marvelous kindness in his city strongholds.
Because in my haste I said, "I have been cut off from your sight!" But you heard the voice of my pleas anyway when I cried out to you.
O all of you who are his saints love the Lord, because the Lord protects the faithful, but plentifully repays the arrogant worker.
All of you who have hope in the Lord, be courageous and he will strengthen your heart.
Blessed is he whose transgression are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
Blessed is the man whom the Lord does not accuse of immorality, and whose spirit has no deceit.
When I kept silent, my bones grew old from my groaning all the day long.
Because day and night your heavy hand was on me, my humidity was turned into summer drought. Praise the Lord!
I have acknowledged my sin to you, and I have not hidden my immorality. I said, "I will confess my transgressions to the Lord!" And you forgave my immoral sins. Praise the Lord!
That's why anyone who is godly prays to you when you can be found, surely when the great waters flood, they will not come near them.
You are my hiding place and you protect me from trouble, you surround me with songs of deliverance. Praise the Lord!
I will instruct you and teach you in the way you must go, I will guide you with my mind's eye.
Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding, whose mouth must be controlled with a bit and bridle, to make them come close to you.
The wicked will receive many sorrows, but whoever trusts the Lord will be surrounded by mercy.
Be glad, shout for joy and rejoice in the Lord, all you who are righteous and honest at heart.
Rejoice in the Lord all you who are righteous, because honest praise is attractive to the Lord.
Praise the Lord with music and sing to him with the harp, psaltery, and ten string instruments.
Sing a new song to him and skillfully play your loud musical instruments.
Because the Lord's word is righteous and all his work is done in truth.
The Lord loves righteous judgment, and the earth is full of his goodness.
The heavens were made by the Lord's word, and all the stars were created by the breath of his mouth.
He gathers the ocean waters together and piles up the depths in his storehouses.
Let the entire earth fear the Lord, let all the world's inhabitants stand in awe of him.
Because he spoke and it was done, he commanded and it stood firm.
The Lord brings the counsel of heathens to nothing, he makes the people's devices ineffective.
The Lord's counsel stands forever and the thoughts of his heart are given to all generations.
Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, and the people he has chosen as his own inheritance.
When the Lord looks down from heaven, he sees all the sons of men.
From his home place, God looks down on all the earth's inhabitants.
He fashions each heart alike and considers all their works.
No king is saved by the multitude of an army, and a mighty man is not delivered by his strength.
A horse is a vain hope for safety, nor will anyone be delivered by his great strength.
Behold, the eye of the Lord is on those who fear him, and on those who hope for his mercy.
To deliver their soul from death, and keep them alive in famine.
Our soul waits for the Lord, he is our helper and our shield.
Because our heart rejoices in him and we have trusted in his holy name.
O Lord, let your mercy be on us because our hope is in you.
I will bless the Lord at all times, his praise will be in my mouth continuously.
My soul will boast in the Lord, the humble will be glad when they hear of it.
Magnify the Lord with me, and let us glorify his name together.
I sought the Lord, and he heard me and delivered me from all my fears.
They looked to him and they were enlightened, and their faces were not ashamed.
This poor man cried out to the Lord, and he heard him and saved him from all his troubles.
The Lord's angel encamps all around those who fear him, and he delivers them.
Taste and see that the Lord is good, blessed is the man who trusts him.
You who are his saints must fear the Lord, because those who fear him want for nothing.
Young lions are lacking and suffer hunger, but those who seek the Lord will not want for any good thing.
Come and listen to me you little children, and I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
What kind of man desires life, and loves to see many good days?
Keep your tongue and lips from speaking evil and deceit.
Depart from evil and do good things, seek and pursue peace.
The Lord's eyes are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their cries.
The Lord's face is against those who do evil, and he will remove the memory of them from the earth.
The righteous cry out, the Lord hears them and delivers them from all their troubles.
The Lord is near those who are broken hearted, and he saves those with a remorseful spirit.
The righteous suffer many afflictions, but the Lord delivers them from all of them.
The Lord protects all of his bones, and not one of them is broken.
Evil will kill the wicked, and those who hate the righteous will be desolate.
The Lord rescues his servants' souls, and no one who trusts him will be desolate.
O Lord, plead my cause with those who struggle against me, and fight those who fight me.
Take hold of a dagger and shield, and stand up to help me.
Also draw out the spear and stop the ways of those who persecute me. Then say to my soul, "I am your salvation."
Let those who seek to harm my soul be confused and put to shame, and let those who devise ways to hurt me be turned back and brought to confusion.
Let them be like chaff in the wind, and let the angel of the Lord chase them.
Let their way be dark and slippery, and let the angel of the Lord persecute them.
Because for no reason they hid their net from me in a pit, which they dug to trap my soul.
Let destruction come on him unexpectedly, and let him catch himself in his hidden net, and let him fall into that very destruction.
And my soul will be joyful in the Lord, and it will rejoice in his salvation.

All my bones will say, "Lord, who else is like to you? Who else delivers the poor from anyone who tries to overpower them with strength. And who else protects the poor and needy from anyone who tries to spoil them?
False witnesses rose up, and charged me with false charges about which I knew nothing.
They tried to spoil my soul by rewarding my good with evil.
But as for me, when they were sick, I grieved wearing sackcloth. I humbled my soul with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.
I behaved as though they were my friend or brother, and I bowed my head heavily, like someone mourning for their mother.
But they rejoiced in my adversity, and even the wretched whom I did not know gathered together against me, and unceasingly slandered me.
Like hypocritical mockers at a feast, they ground me down with their teeth.
O Lord, how long will you look down on this? Rescue my soul from their destructions, and protect my darling from the lions.
I will give you thanks in the great congregation, and I will praise you among many people.
Do not let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over my suffering, and do not let those who hate me for no reason, mockingly wink at each other.
Because they do not speak of peace, but they devise deceitful matters against those who are quiet in the land.
Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me and said, "Aha, aha, we have seen it with our own eyes."
O Lord, you have seen this, so please do not remain silent, O Lord, do not go faraway from me.
O my Lord God, stir yourself up and awaken to my judgment and my cause.
O my Lord God, judge me with your righteousness, and do not let them rejoice over me.
Do not let them say in their hearts, "Ah, this is just what we wanted!" Do not let them say, "we have swallowed him up."
Let those who rejoice when I am hurt be completely ashamed and confused, let those who magnify themselves against me be clothed with shame and dishonor.
Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Let them continuously say, "May the Lord who takes pleasure in his servant's prosperity be magnified."
And my tongue will speak of your righteousness and praise you all day long.
My heart tells me that the wicked do not regret their transgressions, and there is no fear of God before their eyes.
Because he flatters himself so much in his own eyes, that he does not see his own hateful immorality.
Their words are full of immorality and deceit, they have no wisdom and they do no good.
He devises mischief even on his bed, he follows a path that is not good, and he does not abhor evil.
O Lord, your mercy is in the heavens, and your faithfulness reaches up to the clouds.
O Lord, your righteousness is like the great mountains, your judgments are great and deep, and you protect man and beast.
O God, how excellent is your loving kindness! That's why the children of men put their trust under the shadow of your wings.
They will be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of your house. And you will make them drink with the river of your pleasures.
Because with you there is the fountain of life, and in your light we will see light.
Continue giving your loving kindness to those who know you, and your righteousness to the honest at heart.
Do not let the feet of pride come against me, and do not let the hand of the wicked remove me.
There the workers of immorality have fallen, they have been thrown down and they will not rise.
Do not worry because of evildoers, and do not envy the workers of immorality.
Because they will soon be cut down like grass, and wither like green herbs.
Trust in the Lord and do good, so you can live in the land and quite honestly, you will be fed.
Also delight in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Commit your way to the Lord, you must also trust in God and he will make it happen.
He will make your righteousness shine like the morning light, and your judgment like the noonday sun.
Rest in the Lord and wait patiently for him, do not worry about those who use wicked devices to prosper themselves.
Refrain from and abandon anger, and do not worry about evil in any way.
Because evildoers will be cut off, but those who wait on the Lord will inherit the earth.
It will be just a little while until the wicked are gone, and you will diligently look for their place, but they will not be found.
But the meek will inherit the earth, and delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
The wicked plot against the righteous, and the unjust grind their teeth on them.
The Lord will laugh at him, because he sees that his day is coming.
The wicked have drawn their sword and bent their bow, to overpower the poor and needy, and kill those who speak in honest conversation.
Their sword will be thrust through their own heart, and their bows will be broken.
The small portion that a righteous man has is better than the riches of many wicked people.
Because the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the Lord upholds the righteous.
The Lord knows the days of the honest, and their inheritance will last forever.
They will not be ashamed in evil times, and they will be satisfied in the days of famine.
But the wicked enemies of the Lord will perish and they will be consumed like the lamb's burnt fat, that drifts away as clouds of smoke.
The wicked borrow and do not repay their debt, but the righteous shows mercy, and gives.
Because those he blesses will inherit the earth, and those he curses will be cut off.
The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, and he delights in his way.
Even if he falls, he will not be completely overwhelmed, because the Lord upholds him with his hand.
I was young and now I am old, but I have still not seen the righteous forsaken, nor have I seen the descendants of the righteous begging for bread.
The righteous are forever merciful, they quick to lend and their children are blessed.
Leave evil behind, do good and live forever.
Because the Lord loves justice and does not forsake his saints. They are protected forever, but the descendants of the wicked will be cut off.
The righteous will inherit the land, and live there forever.
The righteous speak of wisdom and justice.
His God's law is in his heart and he will not slip.
The wicked watch the righteous and they conspire to kill them.
The Lord will not leave the righteous in the hands of the wicked, nor condemn them when they are judged.
Wait on the Lord and keep his ways, and he will honor you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
I have seen a wicked man with great power, who spread his roots like an evergreen bay tree.
He died and passed away, and I searched for him but I could not find him.
Mark the perfect man and behold the honest, because that man's future is peace.
But the transgressors will be altogether destroyed, the future of the wicked will be cut off.
But the salvation of the righteous comes from the Lord, he is their strength in times of trouble.
The Lord will help them and deliver them, he will deliver them from the wicked, and save them because they trust in him.
O Lord, do not reprimand me in your anger, nor chasten me in your hot displeasure.
Because your arrows pierce me, and I feel your hand pressing hard on me.
There is no health in my flesh because of your anger, nor is there any rest for my bones because of my sin.
Because my wickedness has overwhelmed me, and like a heavy burden my sins are too heavy for me.
My wounds stink and they are decayed because of my foolishness.
I am troubled and greatly overburdened, and I am in grief all day long.
Because my crotch is filled with a loathsome disease, and there is no health in my flesh.
I am feeble and sores have broken out all over me, and I have groaned because of my disturbed heart.
Lord, all of my desires are before you, and my groaning is not hidden from you.
My heart pounds and my strength fails, and the light of my eyes has also left me.
My friends and lovers shun my diseased sores, and my next of kin stand far away from me.
Those who also seek to take my life lay snares for me, and they speak mischievous things about me and dream of deceit all day long to hurt me.
But like a deaf man, I did not hear and I was like a dumb man that does not open his mouth.
In this way, I was like a deaf man who does not hear, whose mouth offers no rebuttals.
Because O Lord, I do hope that you will hear me, O my Lord God.
Because I said, "O Lord, hear me and do not let them rejoice over me when my foot slips, because they magnify themselves against me."
For I am ready to stop, and my grief and sorrows are constantly with me.
Because I will declare my immorality, and I will be remorseful for my sins.
But my enemies are lively and strong, and those who wrongfully hate me are multiplied.
Those who also give evil for good are my adversaries, because I follow everything that is good.
O my Lord God, do not forsake me and do not leave me.
O Lord, please rush to help me with my salvation.
I King David said, "I will take heed of my ways, so that I do not sin with my tongue. And I will control my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked are before me."
I was silent and held my peace, even from speaking good which stirred my sorrow.
While I was thinking my heart grew hot inside me and the fire burned, then I spoke out.
And I said, "Lord, make my future and the end of my days known to me, show me what it is and how frail I am."
Behold, you have made my days as short as the palm of my hand, and my entire lifetime is like nothing to you. Honestly every man's best state is nothing but pure vanity. Praise the Lord!
Surely every man walks in a vain show, surely they are vainly disturbed, he piles up riches not knowing who will harvest them.
And now Lord, what am I waiting for? My hope is in you.
Deliver me from all my transgressions, and do not make me despised by the foolish.
I was dumb and I did not open my mouth, because of what you have done.
Remove your stroke from me, I have been consumed by the blow of your hand.
When you rebuke and correct a man for his immoralities, you consume his beauty like a moth consumes his clothing, surely every man is vain. Praise the Lord!
O Lord, hear my prayers and listen to my cries for help, do not withhold your peace from my tears, because I am a stranger and a traveler with you, as were all my fathers.
Spare me O Lord, so I can recover my strength before I die and leave this place.
I waited patiently for the Lord, then he leaned over and heard my cry.
He also brought me up out of the clay mud in a horrible pit and set my feet on a rock and showed me the way.
He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praises to our God, many will see it and they will fear and trust in the Lord.
Blessed is the man who trusts his Lord and does not respect the proud nor those who turn away from him to lies.
O my Lord God, you have done many wonderful works, and your thoughts toward us cannot be counted up in order to you. If I declare and speak of them, there are more than can be numbered.
You did not desire sacrifice and offerings, you have opened my ears, and you did not require burnt offerings and sin offerings.
Then I said, "I have come, this volume of this book is written about me.
O my God, I am delighted to do your will, and your law is inside my heart."
O Lord, you know that I have preached righteousness in the great congregation, and I have not restrained my lips.
I have not hidden your righteousness inside my heart, I have declared your faithfulness and salvation, I have not concealed your loving kindness or your truth from the great congregation.
O Lord, do not withhold your tender mercies from me, but let your loving kindness and truth constantly protect me.
Because endless evils have surrounded me, my wickedness has taken hold of me, so that I am unable to look up, they are more than the hairs on my head, and that's why my heart fails me.
O Lord, be pleased to deliver me and rush to help me.
Let those who seek to destroy my soul altogether be ashamed and confused, let those who wish evil on me be driven backward and put to shame.
Let those who say to me, aha, aha, be appalled at the desolation of their own shame.
Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you, let those who love your salvation continuously say, "May the Lord be magnified!"
But I am poor and needy, yet the Lord thinks about me, you are my helper and my deliverer. O my God do not delay.
Blessed is he who considers the poor, the Lord will deliver him in times of trouble.
The Lord will preserve him and keep him alive, and God will bless him on the earth, and the Lord will not subject him to the will of his enemies.
The Lord will strengthen him as he languishes on his bed, and restore him from his sickbed.
I King David said, "Lord, be merciful to me and heal my soul, because I have sinned against you."
My enemies speak evil of me and say, "When will he die, and when will his name be forgotten?"
When my enemy comes to see me, he speaks vanity, and his heart is filled with immorality. When he leaves, he reveals his true heart to everyone.
Everyone who hates me gather together and whisper hurtful rumors against me, and they devise ways to hurt me.
They say, "He is afflicted with an evil mental illness, and he will never recover from his lies!"
The one who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me
But be merciful O Lord and raise me up, so that I may show them your truth.
This is how I know that you favor me, because my enemy does not triumph over me.
As for me, you uphold my integrity and set me before your face forever.
Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen!
As deer pant for water brooks, that's how my soul longs for you, O God.
My soul thirsts for the living God, when will I come and appear before God?
My tears have been my food day and night, while men constantly ask me, "Where is your God?"
When I remember these things, I pour out my soul because I have led the multitude to the house of God singing joyous praises, along with those who kept the holy day.
O my soul, why are you so depressed and disturbed within me? Hope in God, because I will continue to praise him for the help from his presence.
O my God, my soul is depressed inside of me, and that's why I will remember you from the land of Jordan, Mount Hermon, and even from Mount Mizar.
The deep calls out to the deep with the noise from your waterspouts, all your waves and clouds have moved over me.
But the Lord will command his loving kindness in the day time, and at night his song will be with me, and I will sing my prayers to the God of my life.
I will say to God my rock, "Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go around mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?"
My enemies spite is like a sword in my bones, while they ask me daily, "Where is your God?"
O my soul, why are you depressed and disturbed inside me? Hope in God, because I will continue to praise him, who gives me my healthy appearance, and who is my God.
O God, judge me and plead my cause against an ungodly nation, deliver me from the deceitful and unjust men.
Because you are the God of my strength, why do you reject me? Why do I have to go around mourning because of my enemy's oppression?
Send your light and truth to lead me, let them bring me to your holy hill and your tabernacles.
Then I will go to my God's altar full of abundant joy, and I will sing praises to you with my harp, O God my God.
O my soul, why are you so depressed and disturbed inside of me? Hope in God, because I will continue to praise him, who gives me the health of my appearance, and who is my God.
O God, we have heard about you with our own ears. Our fathers told us about the works you performed in their day, in the ancient times.
How you drove out the heathen with your hands, and planted our fathers there, how you afflicted the people, and threw them out.

They told us that they did not take the land by their own sword, nor did their own arms save them. But their victory was achieved by your right hand, your arm, and the light from your face because you favored them.
O God, you are my king, command deliverances for Jacob.
Through you we will push down our enemies, through your name we will walk down our enemies who rise up against us.
Because I will not trust in my bow or my sword to save me.
But you saved us from our enemies and put to shame those that have hated us.
We boast in God all the day long, and praise your name forever. Praise the Lord!
But you have rejected us and put us to shame, and you no longer go out with our armies.
You make us retreat from the enemy, and those who hate us take plunder from us.
You have given us up like sheep intended to be butchered for meat, and scattered us among the heathen.
You sell your people for nothing, and your wealth is not increased by their price.
You make our neighbors and those round around us disapprove of, mock, and scorn us.
You make us a perfect example for the heathen, and the people shake their head at us.
My confusion is constantly before me, and the shame on my face has covered me.
Because the voice of the enemy that wants revenge disapproves and blasphemes.
All this has come upon us, but we have not forgotten you nor have we dealt dishonestly in your covenant.
Our heart has not turned back, nor have our steps left your ways.
But you have fiercely broken us in the lair of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
If we have forgotten our God's name, or stretched out our hands to a strange god.
Will not God search this out? Because he knows all the secrets of the heart.
But for your sake we face death all day long, and we are just sheep for the slaughter.
O Lord awaken, why do you sleep? Rise up, and do not reject us forever.
Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
Because our soul is bowed down to the dust, and our stomach clings to the earth.
O Lord rise up, help us and rescue us for your mercies' sake.
My heart is writing about something good, I speak of the things which I have written for the king, my speech comes from the pen of a skilled writer.
You are more beautiful than the children of men, grace is poured into your lips, because God has blessed you forever.
O most mighty, strap your sword to your side with your glory and majesty.
Ride forth in your majesty on behalf of the truth, humility, and righteousness. And may your right hand will teach us awesome things.
Your sharp arrows puncture the heart of the king's enemies, whose people fall under you.
O God, your throne lasts forever and ever, your kingdom's scepter is a righteous scepter.
You love righteousness and hate wickedness, that's why your God has anointed you with the oil of happiness above all others.
Perfume from myrrh, aloe, and cassia scent your clothing, and music from the ivory palaces makes you happy.
Kings' daughters are among your noble women, the queen stood at your right hand wearing jewelry made from the gold of Ophir.
O daughter, listen and consider this, forget your own people and your father's house.
So the king will greatly desire your beauty, because he is your Lord and you love him.
The daughters of Tyre will come with gifts, even the rich people will plead for your favor.
The inside of the king's daughter's chambers is glorious, her clothing is made of golden fabric.
She will be brought to the king wearing embroidered clothes, along with her virgin companions.
They will be brought with happiness and rejoicing, and they will enter the king's palace.
Your sons will take the place of your fathers, you will make them princes throughout the earth.
I will make sure your name is remembered by all your descendants, and that's why the people will praise you forever and ever.
God is our refuge and our strength, his presence is very helpful in times of trouble.
So we will not fear, even when the earth trembles and the mountains fall into the oceans.
Even though its troubled waters roar and the mountains swell and shake. Praise the Lord!
There is a river whose streams bring happiness to God's city, the holy place of tabernacles where the Most High lives.
God is in the midst of the city, she will not be moved, God will help her in her dawning light.
The heathen raged, the kingdoms moved, his voice spoke, and the earth melted.
The Lord of Hosts is with us, the God of Jacob is our refuge. Praise the Lord!
Come and see the Lord's works, behold the devastation he has made throughout the earth.
He ends wars all the way to the end of the earth, he breaks their bows, splits their spears apart, and burns their chariots in the fire.
Be still, and know that I am God, I will be glorified among the heathen, I will be glorified throughout the earth.
The Lord of Hosts is with us, and the God of Jacob is our refuge. Praise the Lord!
All you people clap your hands, and shout to God with a triumphant voice.
Because the Lord most high is awesome, and he is a great king over the entire earth!
He will subdue the people and the nations under our feet.
He will choose our inheritance for us, from the excellence of Jacob whom he loved. Praise the Lord!
The Lord God has gone up with a shout and the sound of a trumpet.
Sing praises to God, sing praises to our king, sing praises, sing praises.
Because God is the king of the entire earth, you must sing praises and understand.
God reigns over the heathen and he sits on his high throne of holiness.
The people's princes have gathered together, even the people of Abraham's God, because the earth's shields belong to God, and he is greatly glorified.
The Lord is great and greatly praised in his city, which is on our God's holy mountain.
It is beautiful in its high position, because the whole earth's joy is on the north side of Mount Zion, which is the great king's city.
God is known in her palaces as a safe haven.
Because when the kings united, they all advanced together.
They saw it and they were shocked, and they were troubled and quickly fled.
Fear took hold of them, like the pain of a woman in labor.
You broke the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
We have heard, and we have also seen in our God's city the city of the Lord of Hosts, and God will establish it forever. Praise the Lord!
O God, we have thought of your loving kindness in the middle of your temple.
O God, your name will be praised until the ends of the earth, and your right hand is full of righteousness.
Let Mount Zion rejoice, and let the daughters of Judah be happy because of your judgments.
Walk around Zion and count all of its towers.
Pay special attention to her defensive walls, and consider her palaces, so that you may tell her next generation.
Because this God is our God forever and ever, and he will guide us even unto death.
All you people and inhabitants of the world, hear this and listen.
Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
My mouth will speak of wisdom, and my heart will meditate on understanding.
I will listen to a parable, and I will open my dark speech with music.
Why should I fear in the days of evil, when the immorality of my enemies surround me?
Those who trust in their wealth, and boast about themselves and the abundance of their riches.
Not one of them can in any way rescue their brother, nor give enough ransom to God for him.
Because the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceases forever.
So that he should still live forever, and not see decay.
Because he sees that wise men die, as well as the foolish, the wicked, and the brutal. They will perish and leave their wealth to others.
Their inner thoughts are that their houses will continue forever. They name their home places after themselves when they give them to all of their descendants.
Nevertheless an honorable man does not endure, he is just like the beasts that perish.
This is their foolishness way, but their descendants approve of their sayings. Praise the Lord!
Like sheep they are laid in the grave, death will feed on them. The honest will have authority over them in the morning, and their beauty will be consumed in the grave from their home.
But God will rescue my soul from the power of the grave, because he will receive me. Praise the Lord!
Do not be afraid when someone is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased.
Because when he dies he will take nothing with him, his glory will not follow him down.
Even though while he lived he blessed his own soul, and men praise you when you do well.
He will go to his fathers' generation, and they will never see the light.
An honorable man does not understand that he is just like the beasts that perish.
The mighty Lord God has spoken, and he called the earth from the rising sun to the sunset.
God's beauty and perfection has shined from Zion.
Our God will come and he will not be silent, a fire will devour everything before him and a turbulent storm will rage all around him.
He will summon the heavens from above and the earth below, so that he may judge his people.
And he said, "Gather my saints around me, the ones who sacrificed and made a covenant with me."
The heavens will declare his righteousness, because God himself is the judge. Praise the Lord!
O my people of Israel, hear me and I will speak and testify against you, because I am even your God.
I do not blame you because your sacrifices and burnt offerings are continuously before me.
I will take no bulls from your house, nor any male goats from your sheds.
Because every animal in the forest and the cattle on a thousand hills, are mine.
I know all the mountain birds, and all the wild field animals are mine.
If I were hungry, I would not tell you, because the world and everything in it is mine.
Will I eat the meat from bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
Offer to God with thanksgiving, and pay what you promised to the Most High.
Call on me on the day of trouble, and I will deliver you, and you will glorify me.
But God speaks to the wicked and says, "What right do you have to declare my laws, or utter my covenant from your mouth?
Since you hate instructions, and you throw my words behind you.
When you saw a thief, you consorted with him, and you have partaken with adulterers.
Your mouth gives evil advice, and your tongue preaches deceit.
You sit and speak against your brother, and slander your own mother's son.
You have done these things and I kept silent, you thought that I was just like you, but I will blame you and set them straight right before your eyes.
Now you who forget God consider this, or else I will tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver you.
Whoever offers praise glorifies me, and I will show the salvation of God to anyone who corrects his conversation."
O God, have mercy on me with your loving kindness and the great abundance of your tender mercies, please forgive me and erase my transgressions.
Wash me thoroughly from my immorality, and cleanse me from my sin.
Because I acknowledge my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
I have sinned against you and you only! I have done this evil in your sight, so that you might be justified when you speak, and you will be clear when you judge.
Behold, I was shaped in immorality and my mother conceived me in sin.
Behold, you desire truth in the inner heart, and you will make me to know wisdom in my hidden thoughts.
Purge me with hyssop and I will be clean, wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Make me hear joy and happiness, so that the bones you have broken may rejoice.
Hide your face from my sins, and erase my wickedness.
O God, create a clean heart in me and renew a righteous spirit inside me.
Do not throw me out your presence, and do not take your Holy Spirit away from me.
Restore to me the joy of your salvation, and uphold me with your free spirit.
Then I will teach transgressors your ways, and sinners will be converted to you.
O God, you are the God of my salvation, deliver me from the blood guilt and I will sing loudly of your righteousness.
O Lord, open my lips and my mouth will reveal your praises.
Because you do not desire nor do you delight in sacrificial burnt offerings, otherwise I would give it.
O God, the sacrifices of God are a broken spirit, and you will not despise a broken and remorseful heart.
