Do good to Zion in your good pleasure, and build the walls of Jerusalem.
Then you will be pleased with the righteous sacrificial burnt offerings, and they will offer whole bulls as burnt offerings on your altar.
O mighty man, why do you boast of mischief? Because the goodness of God endures forever.
The tongue devises mischiefs, like a deceitfully working sharp razor.
You love evil more than good, and lying more than speaking righteously. Praise the Lord!
O you deceitful tongue, you love all devouring words.
God will also destroy you forever, he will take you away and pluck you from your home place, and root you out of the land of the living. Praise the Lord!
The righteous will also see and fear, and they will laugh at him.
This is the man who did not make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and consolidated his power in his wickedness.
But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God, I trust in the mercy of God forever and ever.
I will praise you forever, because you have done it. I will wait on your name, because it is good before your saints.
The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt and they have done abominable immoralities, there are none that do good.
God looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood and sought God.
Everyone of them has turned away from God, they have become altogether filthy and there are none that do good, no, not even one.
Will the workers of immorality always be ignorant? They eat up my people like they eat bread and they have not called on God.
They were in great fear, where there was no fear, because God scattered the bones of those who attacked you. You put them to shame because God despised them.
Oh if only the salvation of Israel were to come from Zion! When God brings back his captive people, Jacob will rejoice and Israel will be glad.
O God, save me by your name and judge me by your strength.
O God, hear my prayers and listen to my words.
Because strangers have risen up against me, and oppressors seek to take my soul, and they have no respect for God. Praise the Lord!
Behold, God is my helper and the Lord is with those who uphold my soul.
He will reward my enemies with their own evil, cut them off from his truth.
O Lord, I will freely sacrifice to you and I will praise your name, because it is good.
Because he has delivered me from all trouble, and my eyes have seen his desire on my enemies.
O God, listen to my prayer and do not hide yourself from my plea.
Attend to me and hear the mourning in my complaint, and make a noise.
Because of the enemies voice and the oppression of the wicked, they throw their immorality on me, and in their anger they hate me.
My heart within me is very distressed, and the terrors of death have fallen on me.
Fear and trembling have come upon me, and horror has overwhelmed me.
And I said, "Oh if only I had wings like a dove! Because I would fly away and find rest.
Then I would wander far away and remain in the wilderness. Praise the Lord!
I would hasten my escape from the windy and violent storm."
O Lord, destroy and divide their tongues, because I have seen violence and conflict in the city.
Day and night they move around on its walls, while mischief and sorrow are in the midst of it.
Wickedness lives within its midst, fraud and deceit never leave her streets.
Because it was not an enemy who disapproved of me, I could have carried that burden. If it were an enemy who hated me and magnified himself against me, I would have hidden from him.
But it was you, a man who was my equal, my guide and my acquaintance.
We trusted each others advice, and we walked together to the house of God.
Let death seize them, and let them quickly go down into hell because wickedness is in their homes, and among them.
As for me, I will call on God and the Lord will save me.
Morning, noon, and night I will pray and cry out loud, and he will hear me.
He delivered peace to my soul from the battle that raged around me, because there were many against me.
God will hear and afflict them, even the ancient ones who have endured since the old days. Praise the Lord! Because they do not change and that's why they do not fear God.
My friend has raised his hand against those who are at peace with him, he has broken his covenant.
His words are smoother than butter, but war is in his heart. His words are as soft as oil, but they were drawn swords.
Throw your burden on the Lord and he will sustain you, he will never allow the suffering righteous to be moved.
O God, I know you will bring them down into the pit of destruction, bloody and deceitful men will not live out half their days, and I will trust in you.
O God, be merciful to me because man would destroy me, and his daily fighting oppresses me.
O Most High, every day my enemies try to destroy me, because there are many that fight against me.
Every time I am afraid, I will trust in you.
I will praise God's word, I have put my trust in God and I will not fear what flesh can do to me.
Every day they force my words, and all their evil thoughts are against me.
They gather together to hide themselves, they track my steps while they lie in wait for my soul.
O God, will they escape through immorality? In your anger throw those nations down.
You speak to my wandering thoughts, you put my tears in your bottle, and are they not in your book?
When I cry out to you, my enemies retreat, I know this because God is for me.
I will praise the Lord God's word!
I have put my trust in God, I will not be afraid of what man can do to me.
O God, your promises are on me and I will give praises to you.
Because you have delivered my soul from death, and you will prevent my feet from falling, so that I may walk before God in the living light!
O God, be merciful to me, because my soul trusts you, I will make my refuge in the shadow of your wings until these calamities have passed.
I will cry out to the Most High God, who performs all things for me.
He will send salvation from heaven, and save me from whoever despises me and wants to destroy me. Praise the Lord! God will send out his mercy and truth.
My soul is among lions, and I lie among those who were set on fire, even with sons of men whose teeth are like spears and arrows, whose tongues are like sharp swords.
O God, be glorified above the heavens, let your glory be above the whole earth.
They have prepared a net to trap me and my soul is depressed, they dug a pit before me, into which they themselves have fallen. Praise the Lord!
O God, my heart is fixed and I will sing and give praise.
Wake up my glory! I myself will awaken early with praising music from the psaltery and the harp.
O Lord, I will praise you among the people, and I will sing to you among the nations.
Because your mercy is great to the heavens, and your truth is up in the clouds.
O God, be glorified above the heavens, let your glory be above the whole earth.
O congregation, do you indeed speak righteously and do you sons of men judge honestly?
Yes, you work wickedness in your heart, you weigh the violence of your hands on the earth.
The wicked are estranged from the womb, they go astray as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
Their poison is like a serpent's poison, they are like the deaf adder who plugs its ears.
Deaf snakes who refuse to listen to snake charmers, who also refuse to hear wisdom.
O Lord God, break the teeth in their mouth, and break the great teeth of the young lions.
Let them melt away like continuously running waters, when he bends his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be cut to pieces.
Let every one of them pass away like a snail which melts or like a woman's untimely birth, so that they never see the sun.
Before your pots can feel the thorns, in his anger he will sweep both the living and the dead away in a whirlwind.
The righteous will rejoice when they sees his vengeance, he will wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
So that a man will say, "Truly there is a reward for the righteous, and he is the God who judges the earth.
O my God, deliver me from my enemies and defend me from those that rise up against me.
Deliver me from the workers of immorality, and save me from blood thirsty men.
Because they lie in wait for my soul, the mighty have united against me, but not for my transgression nor my sin, O Lord.
Behold, through no fault of my own they run to prepare an attack against me, awaken and help me, O God!
O Lord God of Hosts, the God of Israel, awaken and visit all the heathen, do not be merciful to wicked transgressors. Praise the Lord!
They return in the evening, and they go throughout the city barking like a dog.
Behold, they belch from their mouths, their lips are like swords because they say, "Who can hear us?"
But O Lord, you will laugh at the heathen and mock them all.
I will wait on you God because of your strength, because God is my defense.
The God of my mercy will protect me, God will let me see my desire on my enemies.
O Lord our shield, do not kill them or my people will forget, but use your power to scatter them and bring them down.
Because the sins of their lying mouths and their cursing lips, let them be taken in by their own pride.
Consume them in anger, consume them until they do not exist, and let them know that God rules over Jacob until the ends of the earth. Praise the Lord!
Let them return in the evening, and let them run all around the city barking like dogs.
Let them wander up and down looking for meat, and grunt if they are not satisfied.
But yes, I will sing of your power, I will sing out loud of your mercy in the morning, because you have been my defensive refuge on my day of troubles.
O God, I will sing to you, because you are the God of my defense, my strength, and my mercy.
O God, you have been displeased and you have thrown us off and scattered us, please turn back to us again.
You have broken the earth and made it tremble and shake, please heal its broken defenses.
You have shown your people hardship, and you made us drink the wine of astonishment.
You have given a banner to those who fear you, so that it may be displayed because of the truth. Praise the Lord!
Lord God hear me, so that your beloved may be delivered and saved with your right hand.
God's Holiness has spoken, I will rejoice and divide Shechem and distribute the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine, and Ephraim is also the strength of my head, Judah is my lawgiver.
Moab is my washpot, I will throw my shoe over Edom, and I will triumph over Philistia.
Who will bring me into the stronghold city? Who will lead me into Edom?
O God, will you no longer lead us, have thrown us off? O God, will you no longer march out with our armies?
God, help us with our troubles because man's help is vain.
Through God we will act courageously, because he is the one who will walk down our enemies.
O God, hear my cries and attend to my prayers.
I will cry out to you from the ends of the earth and when my heart is overwhelmed, lead me to the higher rock.
Because you have been my shelter, and a strong tower that defends me from the enemy.
I will endure in your tabernacle forever, I will trust in the shelter of your wings. Praise the Lord!
Because, O God, you have heard my promises, and you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
You will prolong the king's life, may his years last for many generations.
He will endure before God forever, prepare your mercy and truth to protect him.
So I will sing praises to your name forever, so that every day I may do everything I promised you.
Truly my soul waits for God, my salvation comes from him.
He is my only rock and my salvation, he is my defense, and I will not be moved.
How long will you imagine mischief against me? All of you will be killed, you will fall like a leaning wall or a tottering fence.
They scheme to overthrow my exalted position, they delight in lies, they bless me with their mouths, but they are cursing me inside. Praise the Lord!
My soul only waits on you God, because my hope comes from you.
Only God is my rock and my salvation, he is my defense and I will not be moved.
God is my salvation and my glory, the rock of my strength and my refuge is in God.
People, trust in God at all times and pour out your heart before him, he is our safe haven. Praise the Lord!
Surely low class men are vanity, and high class men are fakes. Weigh them all on the scales and altogether they weigh less than vanity.
Do not trust in oppression, and do not become vain from robbery. If your riches increase, do not put your heart in them.
God has spoken once, and twice I have heard that all power belongs to God.
O Lord, mercy also belongs to you, because you give every man what their works deserves.
O God, you are my God, I will seek you in the early morning, my soul thirsts for you, my flesh longs for you in a dry and thirsty land where there is no water.
I long to see your power and glory, as I have seen you in the sanctuary.
I will praise you because your loving kindness is better than life.
That's why I will bless you while I live, and I will lift up my hands in your name.
My soul will be satisfied just as fat and marrow satisfy my stomach, and I will praise you with joyful lips.
I will remember you on my bed and I will meditate on you through the night watches.
And I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings because you have been my helper.
My soul clings to and follows you and your right hand upholds me.
But those who seek to destroy my soul will go down into the lower depths of the earth.
They will fall by the sword, and they will be fed to the foxes.
But the king will rejoice in God and everyone who swears by him will be glorified, but the mouths of liars will be stopped.
O God, hear my prayers, protect my life from fear of the enemy.
Hide me from the secret schemes of the wicked, and from the insurrection of the workers of immorality.
Who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot arrows of bitter words.
So they can secretly shoot at the perfectly innocent, and their ignorance will suddenly and fearlessly shoot at him.
They encourage each other in evil things, they privately speak of laying snares for the innocent and they say, "Who can stop us?"
They diligently search out wickedness, both their inner thoughts of everyone around them, and their deep heart is focused on secret wicked plans.
But God will shoot an arrow at them, and suddenly they will be wounded.
So their own lies will fall on them, and everyone will see them flee.
All men will fear and declare the works of God, because they will wisely consider all the things he has done.
The righteous will trust and be glad in the Lord, and all the honest at heart will be glorified.
O God in Sion, praise waits for you and everything that was promised to you will be done.
O you that hears prayers, all flesh will come to you.
Wickedness prevails against me, but you will purge our transgressions away.
Blessed is the man you chose to approach you, so that he may live in your courts. We will be satisfied with the goodness of your house, and even your holy temple.
O God of our salvation, you will answer us with awesome righteousness, you are trusted to the ends of the earth, and by all those who are far across the ocean.
The God whose strength firmly establishes the mountains is clothed with power.
He calms the noise of the oceans and their waves, and ends the chaos of the nations.
Those who live in the farthest parts of the world are afraid of your signs and wonders, you make the outgoing morning and evening tides rejoice.
You visit and water the earth, you greatly enrich it with the river of God, which is full of water that you also provided for the wheat which you prepared for them.
You water its ridges abundantly and settle its furrows, you soften the earth with rain showers, and you bless its sprouting.
You crown the year with your goodness and your paths drip fat.
They drip on the pastures in the wilderness, and the little hills rejoice on every side.
The pastures are clothed with flocks, the valleys are covered with wheat, and they shout and sing for joy.
All nations, make a joyful noise unto the Lord.
Sing about the glory of his honorable name, make his praise glorious.
Say to God, "Your works are awesome! Your enemies will submit themselves to you through your great power.
All the earth shall worship you and sing to you and your name. Selah.
Come and see God's works, he is doing awesome things for the children of men.
He turned the sea into dry land, and we walked through the flood on foot, and we rejoiced in him there.
Through his power he rules forever, his eyes watch the nations. Do not let the rebellious glorify themselves. Praise the Lord!
You people, bless our God and let the sound of his praise be heard.
He protects our soul in life, and he does not allow our feet to suffer or be moved.
O God, you have tried and tested us like refined silver.
You brought us into the net and laid burdens at our feet.
You let men ride over our heads, we went through fire and water, but you brought us into a wealthy land.
I will go into your house with burnt offerings, I will pay you what I promised.
I will keep the promises that I made when I was in trouble.
I will offer fat burnt sacrificial calves to you, with the smoke of savory rams, and I will offer bulls and goats. Praise the Lord!
Everyone that fears God, come and listen and I will declare what the Lord has done for my soul.
I cried out to him and I exalted him with my tongue.
If I keep immorality in my heart, the Lord will not hear me.
But God has truly heard my voice and he has attended to my prayers.
Blessed is God, who has not turned his mercy away from my prayers.
God be merciful and bless us, and make your face shine on us. Praise the Lord!
So that your ways may be known on earth, and the salvation of your health is known among all nations.
O God, let all the people praise you!
O God, let the nations be glad and sing for joy, because you will judge the people righteously, and govern all the nations on earth. Praise the Lord!
O God, let all the people praise you!
Then the earth will yield her bounty, and even our own God will bless us.
God will bless us, and everyone to the ends of the earth will fear him.
Let God rise and scatter his enemies, also let those who hate him flee before him.
Drive them away like smoke is blown away, or as wax melts before the fire, and let the wicked perish in God's presence.
But let the righteous celebrate and rejoice before God and be happy.
Sing to God, and sing praises to his name. Exalt and rejoice before the one who rides on the heavens by his name JAH.
A father of the fatherless, a judge of the widows, is the God who is in his holy home.
God gives the solitary person a family, he frees those who are bound with chains, but the rebellious live in a desert wasteland land.
O God, when you led your people out and marched through the wilderness, praise the Lord.
The earth shook and the heavens dropped in God's presence, even Sinai itself was moved in the presence of God, the God of Israel.
O God, you sent a plentiful rain, which confirmed the inheritance of your promised land when it was dry.
O God, your congregation has lived there, and you have prepared your goodness for the poor.
The Lord gave the word, and there was a great company of those who published it.
Kings of foreign armies quickly fled, and the women that stayed home divided the spoils.
Even though you have laid among the sheep pens, you will be like dove's wings covered with silver and yellow gold feathers.
When the Almighty scattered the kings throughout the land, it was as white as the snow on Mount Zalmon.
Mount Bashan is God's mountain, and a mountain with many high peaks.
Why do you high hills leap? This is the hill on which God desires to live, and the Lord will live there forever.
God has 24,000 chariots and 1,000's angels, and the Lord is among them in his Holy Place in Sinai.
You have ascended on high, he led the captives away, and received gifts for men, even rebellious men. So that the Lord God may live there among them.
Blessed be the Lord, the God of our salvation who loads us with benefits daily. Praise the Lord!
Our God is a God of salvation, and the issues of death belong to the Lord God.
But God will wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of those who continue in their trespasses.
The Lord said, "I will bring my people back from Bashan, and I will bring them up from the depths of the oceans.
So that your foot may be dipped in the of your enemies, and your dog's tongue will lick their blood.
O God, they have seen you leaving, they even saw my God and king marching into the sanctuary.
The singers, musicians, and the girls playing their tambourines led the way.
Bless God in the congregations, bless the Lord from the fountain of Israel.
There is young Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, and the princes of Zebulun and Naphtali.
O God, summon your power and command your strength, your strengthen which has worked for us.
Kings will bring presents to you because of your temple in Jerusalem.
Reprimand the beast of spearmen and the herds of bulls among the calves of the nations, until it submits silver bars, and scatters the people who delight in war.
Princes will come from Egypt, Ethiopia will soon stretch out her hands to God.
O you kingdoms of the earth, sing to God and sing praises to the Lord. Praise the Lord!
To anyone that rides on the highest of heavens of old, behold he sends out his mighty voice.
Give credit to God for your strength, his majesty is over Israel and his strength is in the clouds.
O God, you are awesome in your Holy Places, the God of Israel is the one who gives strength and power to his people. Blessed be God!
O God, save me because the waters are drowning my soul.
I sink in deep mud, where no one is standing, I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
I am weary from crying, my throat is dried out, and my eyes fail while I wait for my God.

Those who hate me without a cause are more plentiful than the hairs on my head, and my mighty enemies would wrongfully destroy me. Even though I stole nothing, I am forced to repay that which I did not take.
O God, you know my foolishness and my sins are not hidden from you.
O Lord God of Hosts, do not let those who wait on you be ashamed on my account. O God of Israel, do not let those who look for you be confused for my sake.
Because I have been despised for your sake, and shame has covered my face.
I have become a stranger to my brothers, and an alien to my mother's children.
Because the zeal of your house has consumed me, and the disrespect of those who despise you has fallen on me.
When I wept and humbled my soul with fasting, it was only to my condemnation.
I also made sackcloth my garments, and I became just a proverb to them.
Those who sit at the gate talk about me, and I was a song for the drunkards.
But as for me, my prayer to you is for an acceptable time of your favor. O Lord God, hear me in the abundance of your mercy and the truth of your salvation.
Deliver me from the mud and do not let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and from the deep waters.
Do not let the flood waters overflow me, do not let the deep swallow me up, and do not let the pit close her mouth over me.
Hear me O Lord, because your loving kindness is good, so turn to me with your abundance of tender mercies.
Do not hide your face from your servant, because I am in trouble, so please rush to answer me.
Draw near to my soul and rescue it, deliver me from my enemies.
You know my disgrace, my shame, and my dishonor, and all my adversaries are before you.
Spite has broken my heart and I am full of sadness. I looked for comforters or someone to pity me, but there were none and I found no one.
They also gave me gall for food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
Let their table become a snare before them, and let what should have been for their benefit become a trap.
Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can not see, and make their body shake continuously.
Pour out your indignation on them, and let your wrathful anger take hold of them.
Let their home be desolate, and do not let anyone live in their tents.
Because they persecute the one that you defeated, and they add to the grief of those whom you have wounded.
Add immorality to their immorality, and do not let them come into your righteousness.
Let them be erased from the Book of Life, and do not include them with the righteous.
But I am poor and sorrowful, so let your salvation set me up on high, O God.
I will praise the name of God with a song, and I will magnify him with thanksgiving.
This will also please the Lord better than an ox or a bull that has horns and hooves.
The humble will see this and be glad, and those who seek God will have hearts that live.
For the Lord hears the poor, and does not despise his prisoners.
Let the heaven, the oceans, the earth, and everything that moves therein praise him.
Because God will save Zion, and he will build the cities of Judah, so that they may live there and have it as their possession.
The descendants of his servants will also inherit it, and those who love his name will live there.
O Lord God, please hurry to deliver me and help me.
Let those who seek my soul be ashamed and confused, and may those who desire to hurt me be turned backwards and confused.
Let those who say, "Aha, aha!" Be turned back as a reward for their shame.
Let all those who seek you, rejoice and be glad in you, and let your love and salvation continuously say, "Let God be magnified."
But I am poor and needy, O God, so hurry to me, O Lord. You are my helper and my deliverer, so please do not delay coming to help me.
O Lord, I do put my trust in you, so never let me be confused.
Deliver me in your righteousness and help me escape, lend me your ear and save me.
Be my stronghold to whom I may continuously turn, you have given your commandments to save me, because you are my rock and my fortress.
O my God, deliver me from the hands of the wicked and from the unrighteous cruel man.
Because O Lord God, you are my hope in whom I have trusted since my youth.
To whom I have been indebted since I was born, you brought me from my mother's womb and I will praise you continuously.
I am like a wonder to many, but you are my strong refuge.
Let my mouth be filled with praise and honor to you all day long.
Do not cast me away in my old age and do not forsake me when my strength fails.
Because my enemies speak against me, and they lay in wait for my soul take scheme and connive together.
And they say, "God has forsaken him, so we can capture him and persecute him, because he has no one to deliver him."
O my God, do not leave me and come quickly to help me.
Let the adversaries to my soul be confused and consumed, and let those who want to hurt me be covered with shame and dishonor.
But I will continuously hope and praise you more and more.
I will speak and reveal your righteousness and salvation all day long, because I do not know the limits of its abundant mercies.
I will enter into the strength of the Lord God, I will only mention your righteousness, and yours alone.
O God, you have taught me from my youth, and until now have I declared your wonderous works.
O God, now that I am old and grey-headed, please do not forsake me until I have shown your strength to this generation, and your power to everyone that is to come.
O God, your righteousness is also very high. O God, you have done great things, and who else is like you?
You, who have shown me great and terrible troubles. You will once again hasten to receive me once more, and bring me up from the depths of the earth.
You will increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
O my God, I will also sing praises to you with the psaltery. O you Holy One of Israel, I will even sing of your truth with the harp.
My soul and my lips will greatly rejoice when I sing to you, because you have rescued me.
My tongue will also talk of your righteousness all the day long, because those who seek to hurt me are confused and they have been brought to shame.
O God, give your wisdom, judgments, and righteousness to the king and the king's son.
He will judge your people and your poor with righteousness and justice.
The righteous mountains will bring peace to the people, and the small hills will bring righteousness.
He will judge the poor people, he will save the children of the needy, and he will break their oppressors into pieces.
They will fear you throughout all generations as long as the sun and moon endure.
He will come down like rain on freshly mowed grass, as showers that water the earth.
In his days the righteous will flourish, as well as an abundance of peace as long as the moon endures.
He will also have authority from sea to sea, and from the river all the way to the ends of the earth.
Those living in the wilderness will bow before him, and his enemies will lick the dust.
The kings of Tarshish and the islands will bring presents, and the kings of Sheba and Seba will offer gifts.
Yes, all kings will fall down before him, and all nations will serve him.
Because he will deliver the poor and needy, and anyone who has no helper when he cries.
He will spare the poor and needy, and save the souls of the needy.
He will rescue their soul from deceit and violence, and their blood will be precious in his sight.
And he will live, and he will be given all the gold of Sheba, and every day they will continuously pray for him.
There will be a handful of wheat on top of the mountains on the earth, its fruit will shake like Lebanon, and the people in the city will flourish like the grass on the earth.
His name will last forever, and his name will continue as long as the sun. Men will be blessed by him, and all nations will call him blessed.
Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who only does wonderous things.
And his glorious name will be blessed forever, and let the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen and Amen.
And this is the end of Jesse's son David's prayers.
Truly God is good to Israel and to those with a clean heart.
But as for me, my feet were almost gone and my steps had nearly slipped.
Because I was envious of the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
Because there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
They are never in trouble like other men, nor are they plagued like other men.
That's why pride surrounds them like a chain, and violence covers them like their clothing.
Their eyes bulge with fat, and they have more than any heart could wish for.
They are corrupt, and they speak highly of wickedness and oppression.
They set their mouths against the heavens, and they wag their tongues throughout the earth.
So his people return here, and cups full of living water are wrung from them.
And the wicked say, "How does in the most high God know, and where does he get his knowledge?"
Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world as they increase their wealth.
Honestly, I have kept my heart clean and washed my hands in innocence for nothing.
Because all the day long have I been plagued and chastened every morning.
If I say, "I will speak about this." Behold I would have offended the generation of your children.
When I thought about this, it was too painful for me.
Until I went into God's sanctuary, then I understood their end.
Surely you set them up in slippery places, and you threw them down into destruction.
How they are suddenly brought to devastation! They are completely consumed with terrors.
O Lord, like a dream when one wakes up, so it will be when you wake up, and you will despise their image.
My heart was grieved by this and my mind was pierced.
I was so foolish and ignorant, and I was like a beast before you.
Nevertheless, I am continuously with you and you hold me by my right hand.
You will guide me with your leadership, and afterward you will bring me to glory.
Who do I have in heaven except you, and there is no one on earth that I desire besides you.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
Because those who are far from you will perish, you have destroyed all of those that go whoring away from you.
But it is good for me to draw near to God, I have put my trust in the Lord God, so that I may declare all of your works.
O God, why have you cast us away forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep in your pasture?
Remember the congregation which you purchased in the past. Remember the staff you inherited and when you rescued Mount Zion, where you now live.
Lift up your feet and walk to the never ending devastation, and everything that the wicked enemy has destroyed in the sanctuary.
Your enemies roar in the middle of your congregations, and they display their flags as signs.
A man was famous as if he had lifted up axes against the thick trees.
But now, all at once they break down its carved work with axes and hammers.
They have thrown fire into your sanctuary, they have defiled it by knocking the home place of your name down to the ground.
They said in their hearts, "Let us destroy them altogether!" And they have burned up all of God's synagogues throughout the land.
We do not see our signs, there are no more prophets, nor is there anyone among us that knows how long all this will last.
O God, how long will your adversary disapprove of you? Will the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
Why do you withdraw your right hand? Reach out and pluck your enemy from your embrace.
Because God is my king from the old days, when he was working salvation on the earth.
You divided the sea with your strength, you broke the heads of the dragons in the waters.
You broke the heads of the leviathan into pieces, and gave his meat to the people living the wilderness.
You held loyally to the fountain and the floods, and you dried up the mighty rivers.
The day is yours and so is the night, you have prepared the light and the sun.
You have set all the earth's borders, and you made the summers and the winters.
O Lord, remember this, so that you disapprove of the enemy and the foolish people who have blasphemed your name.
Do not deliver the soul of your turtledove to the many wicked, do not forget your congregation of the poor forever.
Have respect for the covenant, because the dark places of the earth are full of the homes of cruelty.
Do not let the oppressed return ashamed, let the poor and needy praise your name.
O God, rise up and plead your own cause, remember how the foolish man disapproves of you daily.
Do not forget the voice of your enemies, and the tumult of those who constantly rise up against you.
O God, we give thanks to you, we give thanks to you because your name is near your people. Your people declare your wonderous works.
And God said, "When I receive the congregation I will judge them honestly.
When the earth and all of its inhabitants are dissolved, I uphold its columns. Praise the Lord!
I said to the fools, 'Do not deal foolishly,' and to the wicked I said, 'Do not lift not up your trumpet.
Do not lift your trumpet up high, and do not speak stubbornly.'"
Because exaltation does not come from the east, the west, nor from the south.
But God is the judge, he puts one down and raises another one up.
Because the Lord has a cup in his hand, full of a mixture of red wine and dregs, and he pours out the dregs for all the earth's wicked people to drink.
But I will declare him forever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
I will also cut off all the trumpets of the wicked, but the trumpets of the righteous will be glorified.
God is famous in Judah and his name is great in Israel.
His tabernacle is also in Salem and his home place is in Zion.
Where he breaks the bow's arrows, the shield, the sword, and the battle. Praise the Lord!
You are more glorious and excellent than mountains of prey.
The brave and determined are spoiled, they have slept their last sleep, and none of the mighty men can lift their hands.
O God of Jacob, when you reprimand them, both the chariot and horse are thrown into a dead sleep.
You alone are to be feared, and once you are angry who can stand before you?
You made judgments in heaven, when the earth heard everyone feared and they were still.
Because God rose to judge and save all the meek of the earth. Praise the Lord!
Surely the anger of man will praise you, and you will restrain yourself with those who survive your anger.
Pay to your Lord God what was promised, and let everyone around him bring presents to anyone that should to be feared.
He will cut off the spirit of princes, and he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
I cried out to God with my voice and he heard me.
On the day of my trouble I sought the Lord, my sores oozed in the night without cease, and my soul refused to be comforted.
I remembered God and I was troubled, I complained and my spirit was overwhelmed. Praise the Lord!
You kept my eyes awake and I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
I have considered the days of old and the years from the ancient times.
I remember my song at night, I speak with my own heart and my spirit has diligently searched for truth.
And I thought, "Will the Lord throw off on us forever, will he ever show his favor again?
Is his mercy completely gone forever? Will his promise fail forever?
Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has his anger completely shut down his tender mercies?" Praise the Lord!
And I said, "This is my infirmity, but I will remember the years of the right hand of the Most High."
I will remember the Lord's works, surely I will remember your wonders of old.
I will also meditate on all of your work, and talk of your great works.
O God, your way is holy in the sanctuary, who is as great a God as our God?
You are the God that does wonders, you have declared your strength among the people.
You have rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph with your power. Praise the Lord!
O God, the waters saw you, the waters saw you and they were afraid, the depths were also troubled.
The clouds poured out water and the skies sent out thunder and lightening, that went abroad like your arrows.
The voice of your thunder was in the heaven and the lightning lit up the world, the earth trembled and shook.
Your path led through the sea and the great waters, but your footsteps were not seen.
You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
O my people, listen to my law and pay attention to my words.
I will open my mouth and speak in parables, and I will speak of things that have been hidden since ancient times.
Things that we have heard and known, that our fathers told us about.
We will not hide this knowledge from their children, teaching the generations to come to praise of the Lord. And we will teach about his strength and the wonderful works he has done.
Because he has established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers to make known to their children.
So that the generation to come would know all about them, and their children would grow and teach them to their children.
So that they would put their hope in God and not forget his works, but keep his commandments.

And maybe they would not be like their fathers, who were a stubborn and rebellious generation. They were a generation that did not set their heart correctly, and whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
The children of Ephraim were armed with bows and arrows, but they turned back on the day of battle.
They did not keep the covenant of God and they refused to walk in his law.
And they forgot his works and wonders that he had shown them.
He did marvelous things in sight of their fathers, in the field of Zoan in Egypt.
He divided the sea and made the waters pile up, so they could walk through on dry land.
In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night long he led them with light from a pillar of fire.
He split the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them water to drink as abundant as the great oceans.
He also brought streams from the rock, and made the waters run down like rivers.
But they sinned even more against him by provoking the Most High in the wilderness.
And they tempted God in their heart by demanding meat for their lust.
Yes, they spoke against God and said, "Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
Behold, God struck the rock and the waters gushed out and the streams overflowed. But can he also provide meat and bread for his people?"
And that's why when the Lord heard this, he was angry, so the fire of his anger was kindled against Jacob and Israel.
Because they did not believe in God, and they did not trust in his salvation.
Even though he commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven.
And he rained down manna on them to eat, that he had given to them from the wheat of heaven.
Man ate the angels' food, and he sent them all the meat they could eat.
He made an east wind to blow in the heavens, and by his power he brought in the south wind.
He also rained down meat on them like dust, and winged birds like the sands of the sea.
And he let it fall in the middle of their camp, all around their homes.
So they ate and were well filled, because he gave them their heart's desire.
They were not estranged from their lust. But while the meat was still in their mouths.
God's anger came upon them and killed the fattest of them, and defeated Israel's chosen men.
After all this they continued to sin and despite all of his wonderous works they still did not believe.
That's why he consumed their days in vanity, and their years ended in trouble.
When he killed them, that's when they repented and searched for God.
Then they remembered that their High God was their rock and their rescuer.
Nevertheless, they flattered him with their mouth and lied to him with their tongues.
Because their heart was not right with God, nor were they faithful to his covenant.
But he was full of compassion and forgave their immorality, and he did not destroy them. Many times he turned his anger away, and he did not unleash his full wrath.
Because he remembered that they were mere flesh, like a wind that passes away and does not return.
How often they provoked him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
Over and over they turned away and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
They did not remember his hand, nor the day he delivered them from the enemy.
Nor how he worked his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan.
Or how he turned their rivers into blood, and they could not drink from their streams.
He sent all kinds of flies that devoured them, and frogs that destroyed them.
He also gave their harvests to the caterpillar, and the fruits of their labor to the locust.
He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycamore trees with frost.
He also abandoned their cattle to the hail, and their flocks to hot lightening thunderbolts.
He unleashed the fierceness of his anger along with indignation and troubles, by sending evil angels among them.
He cleared the way to his anger, he did not spare their soul from death, but he turned their life over to the pestilence.
He killed all the firstborn in Egypt, which was their priMary strength in Ham's tabernacles.
But he made his own people leave like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
And he led them safely, so that they did not fear, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
He brought them all the way to his sanctuary mountain, which he had purchased with his right hand.
He also threw the heathen out before them, and divided their inheritance by tribe. Then he settled the Israelis in their tents.
But they tempted and provoked the most high God, and did not keep his testimonies.
But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers, they were turned away like a deceitful bow.
They provoked his anger with their high places, and provoked his jealousy with their carved images.
When God heard this, he was angry and he totally rejected Israel.
So he abandoned the tabernacle tent of Shiloh, which he had placed among men.
He surrendered his strength and glory to captivity at his enemy's hand.
He was also angry with the people of his inheritance and turned them over to the sword.
The fire consumed their young men, and their young women were not given to marriage.
Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows did not lament.
Then the Lord awakened like someone who had been asleep, and began to shout like a mighty man overcome with wine.
So he defeated his enemies and put them to never ending shame.
He rejected Joseph's tabernacle, and refused the tribe of Ephraim.
But he chose the tribe of Judah, and Mount Zion which he loved.

O Lord, come down from your heavens and touch the mountains to make them smoke.
Scatter the lightning, and shoot your arrows to destroy them.
Reach down from above, rescue me and deliver from the great waters, and from the grasp of foreign children.
Foreigners whose mouths lie, and whose right hand is deceitful.
O God, I will sing a new song to you, accompanied by a psaltery and a ten string instrument I will sing praises to you.
He is the one who gives salvation to kings, who delivered his servant David from the deadly sword.
Rescue me and deliver me from the hands of foreign children, whose mouths speak lies, and whose right hand is a deceitful hand of lies.
So that our sons may be like plants nurtured in their youth, and our daughters may be like polished corner stones to adorn a palace.
So that our warehouses may be full, filled with all types of stored goods, so that the sheep on our streets may multiply in the thousands and the tens of thousands.
So that our oxen may be strong and labor productively, so that our walls cannot be breached, and there will be no complaining in our streets.
And all the people whose God is the Lord will be happy people.
O God my king, I will exalt you and bless your name forever and ever.
Every day I will bless you, and I will praise your name forever and ever.
Great is the Lord, and he is to be greatly praised, and his greatness cannot be measured.
One generation will praise your works to another generation, and declare your mighty acts.
I will speak of the glorious honor of your majesty, and your wonderous works.
Men will speak of of your mighty and terrible acts, and I will declare your greatness.
They will abundantly speak of the memory of your great goodness, and sing of your righteousness.
The Lord is gracious and full of compassion, slow to anger and great with mercy.
The Lord is good to everyone, and his tender mercies cover all of his works.
O Lord, all of your works will praise you and your saints will bless you.
They will speak of your kingdom's glory and your power.
To make his mighty acts known to the sons of men, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your authority endures throughout all descendants.
The Lord upholds everyone that falls, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
The eyes of everyone who wait on you are on you, and you give them their food at the right time.

The Lord is righteous in all his ways and his works are holy.
The Lord is near every person that calls on him in truth.
He will satisfy the desire of those who fear him, and he will also hear their cries and save them.
The Lord protects everyone that loves him, but he will destroy the wicked.
My mouth will praise the Lord, and all living creatures will bless his holy name forever and ever.
O my soul, hallelujah and praise the Lord!
While I live I will praise the Lord, I will sing praises to my God while I breathe.
Do not trust your leaders or men, who cannot help.
When he breathes his last breath, his body returns to the earth the very day that his thoughts perish.
Those who hope in the Lord God and are helped by Jacob's God are forever happy.
The God who made heaven and earth, the sea, everything there, and who keeps truth forever.
The God who executes judgment for the oppressed, who gives food to the hungry, and the Lord who turns the prisoners loose.
The Lord who opens the eyes of the blind, the Lord who raises those who are bent over, and the Lord who loves the righteous.
The Lord who protects foreigners and gives relief to the fatherless and the widows, but he turns the ways of the wicked upside down.
O Zion, the Lord your God will reign forever, even to all your descendants. Praise the Lord!
Praise the Lord, because it is good and pleasant to sing praises to our God, because praise is attractive to our God.
The Lord builds up Jerusalem, and he gathers all the outcasts of Israel together.
He heals the broken hearted, and bandages their wounds.
He tells the number of each star, and he calls them all by their names.
Our Lord is great with great power, and his understanding is infinite.
The Lord lifts up the meek, and he throws the wicked down to the ground.
Sing praises to the Lord our God with harps and thanksgiving.
Sing praises to the one who covers the heavens with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, and who makes grass grow on the mountains.
He gives his food to the beasts and the young ravens who cry out for food.
He does not delight in the strength of a horse, and he does not take pleasure in the legs of a man.
The Lord takes pleasure in those who fear him, and those hope for his mercy.
O Jerusalem of Zion, praise your Lord God.
Because he strengthens the bars of your gates, and he blesses the children you carry.
He makes peace within your borders, and fills you with the finest wheat.
He sends his commandments out over the earth, his word runs very swiftly.
He gives snow heavy as wool, and he scatters the grayish frost like ashes.
He throws out his ice like morsels, so who can stand before his cold?
He sends out his word that melts them, then he makes his wind blow and the waters flow.
He shows his word to Jacob, and gives his laws and judgments to Israel.
He has not dealt this way with any other nation, and they have not known his judgments. Praise the Lord!
Hallelujah! Praise the Lord from the heavens, praise him in the heights.
May all his angels praise him! May all his hosts praise him!
May the sun and moon praise him! May all the stars of light praise him!
May all the heavens of heavens and the waters above the heavens praise him!
Let them praise the name of the Lord, because he commanded it and they were created.
He has established them forever and ever, and he has made a decree which will not pass away.
Praise the Lord from the earth, all you dragons and those of deep places.
Fire, hail, snow, vapors, and stormy winds satisfy his word.
Praise the Lord all you mountains, hills, fruit and cedar trees.
Praise the Lord all you beasts, cattle, reptiles, and flying birds.
Praise the Lord all you kings, people, princes, and judges of the earth.
Including all young men, young women, old men, old women, and children.
Let them praise the Lord's name because his name alone is the only excellent name, his glory is above the heavens and the earth.
He also glorifies his people's horns, the praise of all his saints, including the children of Israel, a people near to his heart. Praise the Lord!
Hallelujah! Praise the Lord! Sing a new song of praises to the Lord in his congregation of saints.
Let Israel rejoice in the one that made them, let the children of Zion be joyful because of their king.
Let them praise his name in dance, and let them sing praises to him with the timbrel and harp.
It is because the Lord takes pleasure in his people, that he will beautify the meek with salvation.
Let the saints be joyful in glory, let them sing out loud from their beds.
Let them give God high praises from their mouth, with a double edged sword in their hand.
To execute vengeance and punishments on the heathen and the people.
To bind their kings and nobles with iron chains and shackles.
The honor to execute the written judgment on them is given to all his saints. Praise the Lord!
Hallelujah! Praise the Lord! Praise God in his sanctuary, praise him in the firmament of his power.
Praise God for his mighty acts from his exceptional greatness.
Praise him with the sound of trumpets, praise him with the psaltery and harp.
Praise him with tambourines and dance, praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
Praise him with loud high pitched cymbals.
Let everything that breathes praise the Lord. Hallelujah!
These are the proverbs of King David's son Solomon of Israel.
To know wisdom and instruction, and to perceive the words of understanding.
To receive the instructions of wisdom, justice, judgment, and equity.
To give subtlety to the simple, and knowledge and discretion to the young man.
A wise man will listen and increase his learning, and a man of understanding will obtain wise counsel.
To understand a proverb and interpret the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
My son, hear your father's instructions and do not forsake your mother's law.
For they will be a crown of grace to your head, and chains around your neck.
So my son, if sinners tempt you, do not consent.
If they say, come with us, let us lay in wait for blood, let us secretly lurk for the innocent without cause.
Let us swallow them whole alive like the grave, as those who go down into the pit.
We will find everything precious, and we will fill our houses with spoils.
Throw your lot in with us, let us all have one purse.
My son, do not walk in their ways with them, refrain from their path.
Because their feet run towards evil, and they hurry to shed blood.
Surely their net is spread in vain in sight of any birds.
They lay in wait for their own blood, they secretly lurk for their own lives.
These are the ways of everyone greedy, who are seeking gain which takes away the owners life.
Wisdom cries out in the streets and she speaks.
She cries out and speaks at the main meeting place, at the gate entrances.
And she said, "How long, will you simple fools who love simplicity, and scorners who delight in scoffing hate knowledge?
If you had just turned away at my blame, I would have poured out my spirit to you, I make my words known to you.
But, I called and you refused when I stretched out my hand, and no one responded.
But you would not accept my counsel or any of my blame.
I will also laugh at your disaster, and I will mock you when your fear comes.
When your fear comes as devastation, and your destruction comes as a whirlwind, when distress and anguish overcomes you.
Then they will call on me, but I will not answer, they will earnestly seek me, but they will not find me.
Because that they hated knowledge, and did not choose to fear the Lord.
They would not accept my counsel, and they despised my blame.
That's why they will eat of the fruit of their own making, and they will be filled with their own devices.
Because the turning away of the simple will kill them, and the prosperity of fools will destroy them.
But whoever listens to me will live in safety, and will remain quiet for fear of evil."
My son, if you receive my words, and hide my commandments within you.
If you listen to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding.
If you cry out seeking knowledge, and lift up your voice for understanding.
If you seek her like silver, and search for her as if you were looking for hidden treasures.
Then you will understand the fear of the Lord, and find the knowledge of God.
For the Lord gives wisdom, knowledge and understanding comes from mouth.
He lays up sound wisdom for the righteous, and he is a shield to those who walk in honesty.
He keeps the straight paths of judgment, and protects the way of his saints.
Then you will understand righteousness, judgment, equity, and every good path.
When wisdom enters into your heart, and knowledge is pleasant to your soul.
Discretion will preserve you, and understanding will keep you.
To deliver you from the way of the evil man, and the man who speaks perversely.
Who depart from the honest path to walk in the ways of darkness.
Who rejoice in doing evil, and delight in the stubbornness of the wicked.
Whose ways are crooked and devious.
To deliver you from strange women who flatter with their words.
Who forsakes the guide of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God.
Because her house declines unto death, and her paths lead to the dead.
No one who goes to her returns again, nor do they take hold of the paths of life.
So that you may walk in the ways of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
Because the honest will live in the land, and the perfect will remain there.
But the wicked will be cut off from the earth, and transgressors will be rooted out.
My son, do not forget my law, and let your heart keep my commandments.
For they will add length to your days, and a long peaceful life will be yours.
Do not let mercy and truth forsake you, bind them about your neck and write them on the table of your heart.
So that you will find favor and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding.
Acknowledge God in all your ways, and he will direct your paths.
Fear the Lord and do not be conceited, and leave evil behind.
It will bring health to your body, and marrow for your bones.
Honor the Lord with your possessions, and with the first fruits of your harvest.
So your barns will be filled with abundance, and your presses will burst with new wine.
My son, do not despise the Lord's discipline, nor be weary of his corrections.
Because the Lord corrects the ones he loves, like a father corrects the son in whom he delights.
Happy is the man who finds wisdom, and the man who receives understanding.
Because the Lord's correction is better than silver merchandise, and its gain is better than fine gold.
She is more precious than rubies, and everything you desire cannot be compared to her.
Long life is in her right hand, and riches and honor are in her left hand.
Her ways are pleasant and all her paths lead to peace.
She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her, and everyone that retains her is happy.
The Lord has built the earth with his wisdom, and he has established the heavens with his understanding.
The depths are broken up by his knowledge, and the dew falls from his clouds.
My son, do not let your eyes lose sight of these things, and maintain sound wisdom and discretion.
So they will be life to your soul and grace to your neck.
Then you will walk safely in your ways, and your feet will not stumble.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid, you will sleep soundly and your sleep will be sweet.
Do not fear sudden fright, nor the devastation of the wicked when it comes.
Because the Lord will make you confident, and keep your foot from being taken.
Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is within your power to do so.
Do not say to your neighbor, "Go and come back tomorrow and I will give it to you," when you have it in your hand.
Do not devise evil against your neighbor, when you see that he lives securely near you.
Do not struggle with someone without cause, if they have done you no harm.
Do not envy your oppressor, and do not choose his ways.
Because stubbornness is an abomination to the Lord, and he keeps his secrets with the righteous.
The Lord's curse will be in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the just.
Surely he swears at the scorners, but he gives grace to the lowly.
The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the fool's promotion.
Children, hear your father's instructions and attend his classes to understand.
Because I give you good doctrine, so that you do not abandon my law.
For I was my father's son, young and tender and my mother's only beloved son.
He also taught me and said to me, "Keep my words and commandments in your heart, and live.
Accept wisdom and understanding, and do not forget nor turn away from my words.
Do not forsake her and she will preserve you, love her and she will keep you.
Wisdom is the priMary thing, so gather wisdom and acquire understanding from everything that you do.
Glorify her and she will promote you, and she will bring you honor when you embrace her.
She will cover your head with grace and deliver a crown of glory to you."
O my son, hear my sayings and receive them, so that your life will last many years.
I have taught you the ways of wisdom, and led you along righteous paths.
When you walk, your steps will not falter, and when you run, you will not stumble.
Hold fast to wise instruction, do not let her go, but keep her because she is your life.
Do not enter into the path of the wicked, and do not travel in the ways of evil men.
Avoid it, do not go that way, turn away from it and pass it by.
For they cannot sleep not, unless they have committed mischief, and their sleep is taken away, until they make someone else fall.
Because they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
But the path of the just is like a shining light, that shines more and more on the perfect day.
The ways of the wicked are like darkness, and they do not know what made them stumble.
My son, pay attention to my words, and listen to my sayings.
Do not let them depart from your eyes, and keep them in your heart.
Because they are life to those who find them, and health to their flesh.
Diligently keep them in your heart, because life flows from them.
Put deception away from your stubborn mouth, and do not speak with perverse lips.
Let your eyes look forward and straight ahead.
Ponder your feet's path and establish all of your ways.
Do not turn to the right nor the left, but remove your feet from the evil path.
My son, pay attention to my wisdom and bow to my understanding.
So that you may regard discretion and your lips may speak knowledge.
Because the lips of a strange woman drop like honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil.
But she ends as bitter as wormwood, like a sharp double edged sword.
Her feet lead to death, and her steps walk straight into hell.
You should ponder the path of life, because her ways are unstable, so that you can not know them.
O children, that's why you should hear me now, and do not abandon my words of truth.
Remove yourself far away from her, and do not go near the door of her house.
Or else you will give your honor to others, and your years will go to the cruel.
Strangers will be filled with your wealth, and your labor will be devoted to a stranger's house.
And you will mourn in your last days, when your flesh and body have been consumed.
And you will say, "How I have hated instruction, and my heart refused to accept the blame.
I did not listen to the voice of my teachers nor those who instructed me!
I was almost ruined by the evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly."
So drink water from your own cistern, and running water from your own well.
Why let your fountains be dispersed abroad, and why let your rivers of water run in the streets.
Let them be for you only, and not shared with the strangers among you.
Let your fountain be blessed, and rejoice with the wife of your youth.
Let her be like the loving mother doe and her young fawn to you, let her breasts satisfy you at all times, and may you always be captivated by her love.
My son, why would you want to be captivated by a strange woman, and embrace a stranger's embrace?
Because man's ways are always before the eyes of the Lord, and God ponders everything man has left.
A man's own wickedness will entrap him, and he will be entangled by the cords of his sins.
He will die with ignorance, and he will go astray with his great foolishness.
My son, if you vouch for your friend, or you shake hands with a stranger.
You can be snared and trapped by your own words.
My son, do this now and deliver yourself if you have fallen into your friend's hands, go and humble yourself and make your plea with your friend.
Do not let your eyes sleep or slumber.
Free yourself from the hands of the hunter like a roe, or like a bird from the hands of the fowler.
Consider the ant you sluggard, and be wise.
Ants have no guide, overseer, or ruler.
It prepares her food in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
O you sluggard, how long will you sleep and when will you rise up out of your sleep?
Just a little more sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep.
Your poverty will come upon you as one who travels, and your needs will come on you like am armed man.
A naughty and wicked man, walks with a stubborn mouth.
He winks with his eyes, speaks with his feet, and teaches with his fingers.
He carries stubbornness in his heart, he continuously devises mischief and sows discord.
That's why his disaster will come on him suddenly, and suddenly he will be broken without remedy.
The Lord hates these six things, and seven are an abomination to him.
A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood.
A heart that devises wicked imaginations, and feet that run swiftly into mischief.
A false witness who speaks lies, and someone who sows discord among brothers.
My son, keep your father's commandments and do not forsake your mother's law.
Bind them continuously in your heart, and tie them around your neck.
When you go, it will lead you, when you sleep, it will keep you, and when you wake up, it will talk with you.
Because this commandment is like a lamp and the law is the light, and the discipline of instruction are the way of life.
To keep you away the flattering tongue of a strange and evil woman.
Do not lust not after her beauty in your heart, nor let her deceive you with her eyes.
Because for the cost of a whorish woman a man is brought to poverty, and the adulteress preys upon his precious life.
Can a man embrace fire without burning his clothes?
Can a man walk on hot coals without burning his feet?
So if a man sleeps with his neighbor's wife he will not be innocent.
Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry.
But if he is caught, he must repay seven times more than he stole, and he will forfeit all the wealth of his house.
But whoever commits adultery with a woman lacks understanding, and he destroys his own soul.
He will be wounded and dishonored, and his disrespect will not be wiped away.
Because jealousy makes a man rage, and he will not be spared on the day of vengeance.
He will not be appeased by any ransom, nor will he rest contently, even though you have given him many gifts.
My son, keep my words and store my commandments in your heart.
Keep my commandments and live, and make my law like the apple of your eye.
Bind them to your fingers, write them on the table of your heart.
Speak to wisdom and say, "You are my sister," and call understanding your family.
So that they may keep you from the strange women, who flatters you with her words.
Because, I looked out the window at my house.
Where I saw and recognized a young man who had no understanding at all, among the young and the simple ones.
He was walking through the street near her corner, and he went straight to her house.
In the twilight of the evening, in the black and dark night.
He met a woman with a subtle heart who dressed like a prostitute.
She was loud and stubborn, and her feet would not stay in her house.
She stays outside in the streets, and lies in wait at every corner.
She caught him and kissed him, and with an impudent face he spoke to him.
And she said, "I have brought peace offerings with me, and I paid what I promised to pay on this day.
So I came out to meet you and diligently seek your face, and I have found you.
I have covered my bed with tapestries, carvings, and fine Egyptian linens.
I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
Come, let us make love until morning, and solace ourselves with loving caresses.
Because my husband is not at home, he has gone a long journey.
He has taken a lot of money with him, and he will not be home for many days."
With her enticing speech she made him weak, and with her flattering lips she lured him in.
He immediately followed her, like an ox is led to the slaughter, or as a fool falls into the punishment of the stocks.
Until an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird hurries into the snare, because he does not know that it will cost him his life.
O children, that's why I want you to listen to me now, and pay attention to my words.
Do not let her turn your heart to her declining ways, do not go astray and follow her paths.
Because she has hurt and wounded many men, and she has killed many strong men.
Her house is the way to hell, descending into the chambers of death.
Does not wisdom cry out, and understanding raise her voice?
She stands on top of the high places by the road, between the paths.
She cries out at the city gates, near the entry doors.
O men, I call out to you, and my voice is directed to the sons of man.
O you simple fools, understand wisdom with an understanding heart.
Listen to me, because I speak of excellent things, and my lips will speak of righteous things.
Because I will speak truth, and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
All of my words are righteousness, there is nothing stubborn or perverse in them.
My words are plain to anyone who understands, and righteous to those who search for and find knowledge.
Do not covet silver and gold, but receive my instructions and instead.
Because wisdom is better than rubies, and nothing else that you may desire can be compared to it.
I am wisdom who lives with prudence, and I discover the knowledge of witty inventions.
The fear of the Lord hates evil, and I hate pride, arrogance, evil ways, and a stubborn mouth.
My counsel is my sound wisdom, I am understanding and strength.
Through me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
Through me princes, nobles, and even all the judges on earth rule.
I love those who love me, and those who seek me early on will find me.
Riches and honor are mine, durable riches and righteousness.
My fruit is better than fine gold, and my revenues are better than choice silver.
I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of justice.
So that I may make those who love me inherit substance, and I will fill their treasuries.
The Lord possessed me since the beginning of his ways, before his ancient works.
I was established from the beginning to be everlasting, before the earth began.
I was brought forth before there were watery depths, when there were no springs with overflowing waters.
I was brought here before the mountains were settled, and before the hills were formed.
Before he made the earth, the fields, or the highest dusty plains of the world.
I was there when he prepared the heavens and surrounded the deep waters with land.
I was there when he established the clouds above, and he made the fountains of the deep gush forth.
I was there when he gave his decree to the sea, so that the waters could not surpass his commandment, when he laid out the earth's foundations.
Then I was wisdom near him as one who was raised with him, and I was his daily delight, always rejoicing before him.
Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth, and my delights were with the sons of men.
O you children, that's why I want you to listen to me, because those who keep my ways are blessed.
Hear my instructions and be wise, and do not refuse it.
Blessed is the man who hears me, and waits daily at my door posts watching my gates.
Because whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain the Lord's favor.
But whoever sins against me wrongs their own soul, and everyone that hates me, loves death.
Wisdom has built her house, and she has carved out her seven columns.
She has killed her beasts and mixed her wine, and she has also set her table.
She has sent her young women out, and she cries in the city's highest places.
Whoever is simple, let him turn in here, as for anyone that wants understanding, she says to him.
And she said, "Come, and eat my bread, and drink the wine I have mixed.

Whoever blames a scorner brings shame on himself, and someone that reprimands a wicked man receives a dark stain against himself.
Do not blame a scorner, or else he will hate you, but if you reprimand a wise man, he will love you.
Give instruction to a wise man, and he will become more wise, teach a just man, and he will increase in knowledge.
Fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One brings understanding.
Because your days will be multiplied by me, and the length of your life will be increased.
If you are wise, you will be wise for your benefit, but if you swear, you alone will bear the blame.
A foolish woman is loud and unruly, she is simple and knows nothing.
She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the city heights.
Calling out to those who travel in righteous ways.
And she says to anyone that lacks understanding, "If you are simple, turn in here.
Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret tastes pleasant."
But he does not know that the dead are there, and she leads her guests to the depths of hell.
These are Solomon's proverbs. A wise son makes a happy father, but a foolish son is his mother's sadness.
The treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
The Lord will not allow the righteous soul to suffer starvation, but he throws away the wealth of the wicked.
Those with a negligent hand become poor, but the diligent hand creates wealth.
The son who harvests in summer is a wise son, but the son who sleeps through harvest is a son that causes shame.
Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
The wise at heart will receive commandments, but a fool talking foolishly will fall.
Whoever walks uprightly walks securely, but whoever perverts his ways will become known.
Those who wink cause sorrow, but a fool talking foolishly will fall.
The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
Hatred stirs up strifes, but love covers all sins.
Within anyone who understands, wisdom is found, but the rod is for the back of anyone lacks understanding.
Wise men store up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish invites destruction.
The rich man's wealth is his stronghold, the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
The righteous labor to care for life, the fruit of the wicked is sin.
Whoever accepts instructions is on the way of life, but whoever refuses to accept responsibility for their own decisions, goes astray.
Whoever hides hatred with lying lips and utters slander against others, is a fool.
Sin is inevitable when words are many, but whoever refrains their lips is wise.
The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver, but the heart of the wicked is worth little.
The words of the righteous feed many, but fools die from lack of wisdom.
The Lord's blessing makes wealth, and he adds no sorrow with it.
It is like sport to a fool to do mischief, but a man of understanding has wisdom.
The fear of the wicked will come on a fool, but the desires of the righteous will be granted.
As the whirlwind passes the wicked is no more, but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, is how the sluggard is to those who sent him.
The fear of the Lord prolongs days, but the years of the wicked will be shortened.
The hope of the righteous will be happiness, but the expectations of the wicked will perish.
The way of the Lord is strength to the honest, but destruction awaits the immoral workers.
The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not inhabit the earth.
The mouth of the just brings wisdom, but the stubborn tongue will be cut out.
The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked speaks stubbornness.
A false measurement is an abomination to the Lord, but an honest weight delights him.
When pride comes so does shame, but wisdom is with the lowly.
The integrity of the honest will guide them, but the perverseness of the wicked will destroy them.
Riches do not profit on the day of anger, but righteousness delivers from death.
The righteousness of the perfectionist will direct his way, but the wicked will fall by his own wickedness.
The righteousness of the honest will deliver them, but the wicked will be taken by their own naughtiness.
When a wicked unjust man dies, his hopes and expectations perish.
The righteous are delivered from trouble, and the wicked shows up in his place.
A hypocrite destroys his neighbor with his mouth, but through knowledge the righteous and just will be delivered.
The city rejoices when everything goes well for the righteous, but when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.
By the blessing of the honest glorifies the city, but it is overthrown by the wicked mouth.
Someone void of wisdom will despise his neighbor, but an understanding man holds his peace.
A gossiper reveals secrets, but a faithful spirit conceals the these things.
The people fall where there is no wise counsel, but there is safety among a multitude of counselors.
Whoever puts up security for a stranger will suffer for it, but whoever hates debt is secure.
A gracious woman retains her honor, and strong men retain their wealth.
The merciful man does good for his own soul, but a cruel man only troubles himself.
The wicked do deceitful things, but anyone who sows righteousness will be assured of their good reward.
Righteousness leads to life, but the pursuit of evil pursues leads to death.
Those who have a stubborn heart are an abomination to the Lord, but those who are honest in their ways are his delight.
Those who join hands with the wicked will not go unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be protected.
A beautiful woman without discretion, is like a gold ring in a pig's snout.
The desires of the righteous lead only to good things, but the expectations of the wicked bring only anger.
Those who scatter their wealth will increase, and those who withhold more than they need fall into poverty.
The liberal soul will prosper, and the one that waters will also be watered.
Whoever withholds food will be cursed by the people, but anyone who sells it will be blessed.
Anyone that diligently seeks good buys favor, but whoever seeks mischief will find it.
Anyone that trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will flourish like a branch.
Anyone that troubles his own house will inherit the wind, and the fool will be a servant to the wise at heart.
The fruit of the righteous is the tree of life, and whoever wins souls is wise.
Behold, the righteous will be compensated by the earth, much more than the wicked sinner.
Whoever loves instructions loves knowledge, but whoever hates being corrected is wicked and brutal.
A good man obtains the Lord's favor, but the Lord condemns a man who devises wicked devices.
A man can not be established by wickedness, but the righteous can not be moved.
A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband, but she who makes shame rots his bones.
The thoughts of the righteous are righteous, but the wicked counsels deceit.
The words of the wicked lie in wait for innocent blood, but an honest mouth will deliver them.
The wicked are overthrown and they perish, but the house of the righteous will stand.
A man will be commended according to his wisdom, but if he has a perverse heart, he will be despised.
It is better to be despised and have a servant, than it is to honor yourself and have no bread.
A righteous man regards his animals lives, but the tender mercies of the wicked are only cruelty.
A man that works his land will be satisfied with bread, but a man who follows vain people has no understanding.
