To the only wise God our savior be the glory, majesty, authority and power both now and ever. Amen.
These are the Revelations which God gave to Jesus Christ. The Revelations of things that must soon come to pass which were shown to his servant John by his angel.
John testified about everything that he had seen, including Jesus Christ's testimony, and the word of God which he'd heard.
And John said, "Blessed are those who read this prophecy, and those who hear it and take to heart what's written here, because the time is near."
John wrote to the seven churches in Asia and said, "Grace be unto you and peace from him who is, was, and who is to come.
And from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, firstborn of the dead, and ruler of the earth's kings, to the one who loves us and has freed us from our sins by his blood.
And he who reveals what is to come, whose made us kings and priests to his God and father, to him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
Behold, he comes with the clouds, and every eye will see him, even those who pierced him; and everyone on the earth will mourn over him. So it is to be. Amen.
The Lord says,"`I am God Almighty, the Alpha and the Omega, the who is, who was, and who is to come.´"

I am your brother John, who shares Jesus Christ's trials and tribulations, his patience, and his and kingdom with you. I was on the island of Patmos because of God's word and Jesus Christ's testimony.
I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day when I heard a loud trumpet that sounded like a voice behind me.

The one who spoke to me said, "`I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end. Write what you see in a book and send it to the seven churches in Asia, Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.´"
Then I turned to see who was speaking to me, and I saw seven golden lampstands.
In the midst of the seven golden lampstands I saw someone who looked like the Son of Man, clothed in a long robe with a golden sash around his chest.
His head and hair were like white wool, they were as white as snow, and his eyes were like the flames of a fire.
His feet were like polished bronze, refined in a furnace, and his voice was like the sound of many waters.
He had seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double edged sword came out of his mouth, and he was shining as bright as the sun.
And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as if I were dead, and he laid his right hand on me and said, "`Fear not, I am the first and the last.´
`I am the one who was dead and now I live, behold I will live forever and I have the keys to death and hell.´
`Write everything you have seen, the things which are now, the things that are to come, and the things that will last forever.´

`Write about the mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand and the seven golden lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands which you saw are the seven churches.´"

God gave these Revelations to Jesus Christ, who gave them to John and told him to write to the angel of the church of Ephesus and say, "`The one who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands says,´

`'I know your works, your labor, faith, and patience, and I know that you cannot tolerate evil people. I know that you have tried those who falsely profess to be apostles, and that you have found them to be liars.´
`And I have carried on, I was patient, I served in your name, and I did not give up.´
`Nevertheless, I have one complaint, you have lost your original love for me.´
`Think about how far you have fallen. Repent and return to your first love, or I will come to you soon and remove your light from its place. I will only spare you if you repent of your sins.´
`But I commend you because you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.´
`He who has an ear, hear what the Holy Spirit has to say to the churches: To those who overcome, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life which is in the middle of God's paradise.'´"
Write to the angel of the church in Smyrna and say: "`This message is from Jesus Christ who is the first and the last, who was dead but is still alive who said,´
`'I know your works, suffering, poverty, and persecution, but you are rich in faith. I also know the blasphemy of those who falsely claim to be Jews but are instead Satan's synagogue.´

`Do not be afraid of the things that you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into prison, and you will be tried. You will suffer for ten days, but if you are faithful unto death, I will give you a crown of life.´
`If you have ears, listen to what the Holy Spirit has to say to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be hurt by the second death.'´"
Write to the angel of the church of Pergamum and say: "`This is what the one with the sharp double-edged sword says,´

`'I know your works, where you live, and the location of Satan's seat. And I know that you hold firmly to my name, and you have not denied your faith in me, even when my faithful witness Antipas was killed where Satan lives.´

`But I have a few things against you, because you have people there who hold to the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelis so they would sin by eating food sacrificed to idols and commit fornication.´
`You also have those with you who follow the teachings of the Nicolaitans, which I hate.´
`Repent, otherwise I will come to you soon and fight against those who oppose me with the sword of my mouth.´

`Whoever has an ear, listen to what the Holy Spirit has to say to the churches. To those who overcome sin, I will give some hidden manna to eat.I will also give them a white stone with a new name written on it, that no one knows except for the one who receives it.'´"
Write to the angel of the church in Thyatira and say: "`'The Son of God says, 'I have eyes like flames of fire and feet like polished bronze.´

`I know your works, your labor, faith, and patience, and I know that you cannot tolerate evil people. I know that you have tried those who falsely profess to be apostles, and that you have found them to be liars.´
`But I do have a few things against you because you tolerate Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She is leading my servants into sin; she is also teaching sexual immorality and idol worship.´
`I gave her a chance to repent from her sin, but she refused.´
`Behold, I will make her sick, and those who commit adultery with her will also suffer greatly, unless they turn away from their sin.´
`And all of the churches will know that I am the one who searches the minds, hearts and souls of men because I will kill her children, and I will give each one of you whatever you deserve.´
`But to you and the rest of the people in Thyatira who do not hold these beliefs and have not known the depths of Satan, I will place no other burden on you.´
`But hold fast to what you have until I come.´
`I will give authority over the nations to the one who overcomes and remains faithful to my teachings until the very end.´
`And he will rule over them with an iron rod, and they will be shattered like a potter's vessel, just as I have received authority from my Father.´
`And I will give him the morning star.´
`Whoever has an ear, let them hear what the Holy Spirit has to say to the churches.'´"

Jesus gave these revelations to John and told him to write to the angel of the church in Sardis and say: "`This message is from the one who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds and your reputation for being alive, but you are dead.´
`Be watchful, and strengthen what remains which was ready to die, because I have not found your works to be perfect before God.´
`Therefore, remember what you have received and heard, then hold fast and repent. For if you do not watch, I will come like a thief, and you will not know what hour I will come upon you.´
`You have a few names even in Sardis who have not defiled their garments, and because they are worthy, they will walk with me in white.´
`The one who overcomes, will be clothed in white clothes, and I will not erase his name from the Book of Life, but I will confess his name before my father and his angels.´
`Whoever has an ear, let them hear what the Holy Spirit has to say to the churches.´"

And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write and say: "`These things were said by Jesus who is holy and true, who has the key of David. What Jesus opens, no man can shut, and what he shuts, no man can open:´
`'I know your works, behold I have set an open door before you, and no man can shut it. For you have a little strength, and you have kept my word, and you have not denied my name. ´

`Behold, those who say they are Jews, but they are not and they lie, I will make part of the synagogue of Satan. Behold I will make them come and worship before your feet, and they will know that I have loved you.´
`Because you have kept my word to be patient, I also will keep you from the hour of temptation, which will come upon the whole world, to test those who live on the earth.´
`Behold, I am coming soon. Hold that fast to what you have, so that no man can take your crown.´

`I will make whoever overcomes a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will no longer leave. And I will write the name of my God on him, and the name of my God's new city of Jerusalem which comes down from my God in heaven, and also my new name.´
`Whoever has an ear, let them hear what the Holy Spirit has to say to the churches.'´"
And to the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write and say: "`These things are said by the Amen, the faithful and true witness, and the beginning of God's creation.´
`I know your works, and you are neither cold nor hot, I wish you were either cold or hot.´
`So then because you are lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue you out of my mouth.´
`Because you say, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing, and do not know that you are wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked.´

`I counsel you to buy for me gold refined in the fire, so that you may be rich, and white clothes, so that you may be clothed, and that the shame of your nakedness does not appear, and anoint your eyes with eye salve, so that you may see.´
`As many as I love, I reprimand and chasten, therefore be zealous and repent.´
`Behold, I stand at the door and knock, if a man hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him, and I will eat with him, and he will eat with me.´
`To anyone who overcomes will I grant the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I also overcame, and am set down with my father on his throne.´
`He that has an ear, let him hear what the Holy Spirit has to say to the churches.´"

After this I looked and behold a door was opened in heaven. And the first voice I heard sounded like a trumpet talking to me, which said, "Come up here, and I will show you things which must happen in the future."
And immediately I was in the spirit and behold I saw a throne set up in heaven, and someone was sitting on the throne.
And the one sitting on the throne looked like jasper and sardine stone, and there was a rainbow all around the throne that looked like an emerald.
There were twenty-four seats all around the throne, and I saw twenty-four elders sitting there, clothed in white clothes and gold crowns on their heads.
And thunder, lightning. and voices came from the throne, and there were seven fiery burning lamps before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
And before the throne there was a sea of glass like crystal, and in the middle of and all around the throne, were four beasts full of eyes in front and behind.
The first beast was like a lion, the second beast like a calf, the third beast had a face like a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.

Each of the four beasts had six wings, and they were full of eyes all around and inside. They did not rest day or night and they said, "Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God Almighty, who is, was, and is to come!"
And when those beasts give glory, honor, and thanks to the one God seated on the throne, who lives forever and ever.
The twenty-four elders fall down before God seated on the throne, and worship the one God who lives forever and ever, and they threw their crowns before the throne and said,
"O Lord, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power because you have created all things, which were all created for your pleasure."
Then I saw a book in the right hand of the one God sitting on the throne. It had writing on both front and back and inside, and it was sealed with seven seals.
And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice: "Who is worthy to open the book, and break its seals?"
And no one in heaven, on earth, nor under the earth, was able to open the book nor look inside of it.
And I wept a lot because no one was found to be worthy enough to open and read the book, nor even look inside of it.
And one of the elders spoke to me and said, "Do not weep, for behold the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, has prevailed to open the book, and to break its seven seals.

Then I looked and saw a lamb that had been killed, standing in the middle of the throne surrounded by the four beasts and the elders. The lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
And Jesus came and took the book from the right hand of the one God who sat on the throne.
After Jesus had taken the book, the four beasts and twenty-four elders fell down before the lamb, each one of them had harps, and golden vials full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

And they sang a new song and said, "You are worthy to take the book, and open its seals, because you was slain, and have redeemed us by your blood for God from every tribe, tongue, people, and nation.
You have made us kings and priests to serve our God; and we will reign on the earth.
And I looked and heard the voice of many angels all around the throne, the beasts, and the elders, and their number was 10,000 times 10,000, and 1,000's of 1,000's.
With a loud voice they said, "Worthy is the lamb of God who was killed to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessings!"

And I heard every creature in heaven, on earth, under the earth and in the sea, and everything that is in them saying, "Blessing, honor, glory, and power, be to the one God who sits on the throne, and to the lamb of God forever and ever!"
And the four beasts said, "Amen!" And the twenty-four elders fell down and worshipped the one God who lives forever and ever.
Then I saw the lamb of God open one of the seals, and I heard one of the four beasts that sounded like thunder saying, "Come and see."
So I looked and saw a white horse, and the one who sat on him had a bow. And he was given a crown, and he left to overcome and conquer.
After the lamb of God had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, "Come and see."
And another horse left that was red, and power was given to the one who was seated on him to take peace away from the earth, so that men would kill one another. And he was given a great sword.
After the lamb of God had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, "Come and see." And behold I saw a black horse, and the one who sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
And I heard a voice in the middle of the four beasts say, "A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny, and do not hurt the oil and wine."
After the lamb of God had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, "Come and see."

Then I looked and I saw a pale horse, and the name of the one who sat on him was Death and Hell followed close behind him. And they were given power to kill over 1/4th of the earth with sword, hunger, plague, and by the beasts of the earth.
After the lamb of God had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who were killed for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held.
And they cried out with a loud voice and said, "How long, O Lord, holy and true, before you avenge our blood and judge those who live on the earth?"

And white robes were given to every one of them, and they were told that they should rest for just a little while longer, until their fellow servants and their brothers who should be killed just as they were, to fulfill the scripture.
Then I saw the lamb of God open the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake and the sun turned as black as goat hair sackcloth, and the moon turned blood red.
And the stars of heaven fell to the earth, just as a fig tree drops her unripe figs when she is shaken by a mighty wind.
The heavens disappeared like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved out of place.
And the earth's kings, great men, rich men, chief captains, mighty men, and every slave and free man, hid in the caves and among rocks of the mountains.
Then they called out to the mountains and rocks and said, "Fall on us, and hide us from the face of the one God who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the lamb of God.
For the great day of his wrath has come, and who can withstand it?"
After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, withholding the four winds of the earth, so the wind could not blow on the earth, the sea, nor on any trees.
And I saw another angel ascending from the east with the seal of the living God. And he cried out in a loud voice to the four angels who were given the power to hurt the earth and the sea.
And this angel said, "Do not hurt the earth, the sea, nor the trees, until we have sealed the foreheads of the servants of our God."
And I heard the number of those who were sealed, and there were 144,000 from all of the Israelis tribes.
From the tribe of Juda 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Reuben 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Gad 12,000 were sealed.
From the tribe of Aser 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Nephthalim 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Manasses 12,000 were sealed.
From the tribe of Simeon 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Levi 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Issachar 12,000 were sealed.
From the tribe of Zebulon 12,000 were sealed, and 12,000 were sealed from the tribe of Joseph, and 12,000 were sealed from the tribe of Benjamin.

After this I saw great crowds too large to count from all nations, tribes, people, and tongues who stood before the throne and the lamb of God. They were clothed in white robes with palm branches in their hands.
And they cried out in a loud voice and said, "Salvation to our God who sits on the throne, and to the lamb of God."
And all the angels stood around the throne and around the elders and the four beasts. And they fell facedown before the throne and worshipped God.
And they all said, "Amen, may all the blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever. Amen."
Then one of the elders addressed me and said, "Who are these arrayed here in white robes, and where did they come from?

And I answered him and said, "Sir, you know." And he spoke to me and said, "These are those who came out of the great tribulation, they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the lamb of God.
Therefore, they are before the throne of God, and they serve him in his temple day and night, and the one God who sits on the throne will live among them.
They will no longer hunger nor will they thirst ever again, nor will the sun light beat down on them, nor will they be scorched by the heat.
For the lamb of God who is in the middle of the throne will feed them, and the Lord will lead them to living fountains of water, and God will wipe away all their tears from their eyes."
After the lamb of God had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
And I saw the seven angels who stood before God, and they were given seven trumpets.
Then another angel came and stood at the altar with a golden censer, and he was given much incense, to offer along with all the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar before the throne.
And the incense smoke along with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God from the angel's hand.
And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it onto the earth and there were voices, thunder, lightning, and an earthquake.
And the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.
The first angel sounded his trumpet, which was followed by hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth, and 1/3rd of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.
Then the second angel blew his trumpet, and what looked like a great flaming mountain was thrown into the sea, and 1/3rd of the ocean turned into blood.
And 1/3rd of the living creatures in the sea died, and 1/3rd of the ships were destroyed.
Then the third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star fell from heaven, burning as if it were a lamp, and it fell on 1/3rd of the rivers, and on the water fountains.
And the name of the star was Wormwood, and 1/3rd of the waters became wormwood, and many men died from the bitter water.
And the fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and 1/3rd of the sun, moon, and stars were struck, and 1/3rd of the stars were darkened, and 1/3rd of the light did not shine in the day or the night.

Then I saw and heard an angel flying through the middle of heaven speaking in a loud voice that said, "Woe, woe, woe unto the inhabitants of the earth because of the other trumpet voices of the three angels, which are yet to be sounded!"
And the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star fall from heaven to the earth, and the key to the bottomless pit was given to him.
Then he opened the bottomless pit, and smoke rose from the pit, like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.
And from the smoke locusts swarmed on the earth, and they were given power like the scorpions of the earth.
But they were commanded not to hurt the grass of the earth or any other green plant or tree, but they could only torment those who did not have the seal of God in their foreheads.
The locusts were not allowed to kill them, but that they could torment them for five months, and their torment was like the sting of a scorpion when it strikes a man.
In those days will men seek death, but they will not find it, and they will desire to die, and death will flee from them.
And the locusts were shaped like horses prepared to do battle, and on their heads was something like gold crowns, and their faces were like the faces of men.
And their hair looked like women's hair, and their teeth were like the teeth of lions.
And they had what looked like iron breastplates, and the sound of their wings was like the sound of many horse chariots running into battle.
And they had tails like stinging scorpion tails, and they had the power to hurt men for five months.
A king ruled over them, who is the angel of the bottomless pit. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, but in Greek his name was Apollyon.
Then one sorrow passed but behold there were two more sorrows to follow.
And the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God.
The voice spoke to the sixth angel who had the trumpet and said, "Release the four angels who are bound in the great Euphrates River."
And the four angels who had been prepared for this hour, day, month, and year, were turned loose to kill 1/3rd of mankind.
And there was an army of 200,000,000 horsemen, and I heard how many of them there were.

And in this vision, I saw the horses, and those who sat on them, and they had breastplates made of fire, jacinth, and brimstone. The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions and fire, smoke, and brimstone came from their mouths.
They killed 1/3rd of all men by fire, smoke, and brimstone which came from their mouths.
For their power is in their mouth and tail, because their heads and tails were like serpents, and they used them to hurt people.

The rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent from the works of their hands. They would not stop worshiping devils and idols made of gold, silver, brass, stone, and wood, which cannot see, hear, or walk.
They did not repent of their murders, sorceries, fornication, and thefts.
And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed in a cloud, with a rainbow on his head, and his face looked as it were the sun, and his feet were like columns of fire.
And he had in his hand a little book open, and he set his right foot on the sea, and his left foot on the earth.
And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roars, and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write, and I heard a voice from heaven saying to me, seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.
And the angel which I saw stand on the sea and on the earth lifted up his hand to heaven.

And swore by anyone that lives forever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that in there are, and the earth, and the things that in there are, and the sea, and the things which are in there, that there should be time no longer.
But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he will begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he has declared to his servants the prophets.
And the voice which I heard from heaven spoke to me again and said, go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which stands on the sea and on the earth.
And I went to the angel, and said to him, give me the little book, and he said to me, take it, and eat it up, and it will make your stomach bitter, but it will be in your mouth sweet as honey.
And I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up, and it was in my mouth sweet as honey, and as soon as I had eaten it, my stomach was bitter.
And he spoke to me and said, you must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.
And there was given me a reed like to a rod, and the angel stood and said, rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and those that worship in there.
But the court which is outside the temple leave out, and measure it not, because it is given to the Gentiles, and the Holy city will they walk under foot for 42 months.
And I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.
These are the two olive trees, and the two lampstands standing before the God of the earth.
And if a man will hurt them, fire proceeds out of their mouth, and devours their enemies, and if a man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.
These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy, and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to defeat the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
And when they will have finished their testimony, the beast that ascends out of the bottomless pit will make war against them, and will overcome them, and kill them.
And their dead bodies will lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
And they of the people and relatives and tongues and nations will see their dead bodies three days and a half, and will not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.
And they that live on the earth will rejoice over them, and make merry, and will send gifts one to another, because these two prophets tormented those that lived on the earth.
And after three days and a half the spirit of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell on them which saw them.
And they heard a great voice from heaven saying to them, come up here, and they ascended up to heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.
And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and 1/10 of the city fell, and in the earthquake were 7,000 men were killed, and the rest were frightened, and gave glory to the God of heaven.
The second sorrow is past, and, behold the third sorrow comes quickly.
And the seventh angel sounded, and there were great voices in heaven and said, the kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ, and he will reign forever and ever.
And the twenty-four elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell on their faces, and worshipped God.
Saying, we give you thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which are, and was, and are to come, because you have taken to you your great power, and have reigned.

And the nations were angry, and your anger has come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that you should give reward to your servants the prophets, and to the saints, and those that fear your name, small and great, and should destroy them which destroy the earth.
And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament, and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.
And a great wonder appeared in heaven, a woman clothed in the sun, with the moon under her feet, and on her head was a crown of twelve stars.
And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.
And there appeared another wonder in heaven, and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns on his heads.

And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and threw them to the earth, and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, because to devour her child as soon as it was born.
And she brought a baby boy, who was to rule all nations with an iron staff, and her child was brought up to God, and to his throne.
And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there for 1,260 days.
And there was war in heaven, Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon fought and his angels.
And did not prevail, neither was their place found anymore in heaven.
And the great dragon was thrown out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceives the whole world, he was thrown out into the earth, and his angels were thrown out with him.

And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, salvation and strength have now come, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ, because the accuser of our brothers is thrown down, which accused them before our God day and night.
And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb, and by the word of their testimony, and they did not love their lives until the death.

And for that reason rejoice, you heavens, and you that live in them. Sorrow to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! For the devil has come down to you, having great anger, because he knows that he has but a short time.
And when the dragon saw that he was throw to the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought the man child.

And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
And the serpent thrown out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.
And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon thrown out of his mouth.
And the dragon was angry with the woman, and went to make war with the remains of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
And I stood on the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his horns ten crowns, and on his heads the name of blasphemy.

And the beast which I saw was like to a leopard, and his feet were like the feet of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion, and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death, and his deadly wound was healed, and all the world wondered after the beast.
And they worshipped the dragon which gave power to the beast, and they worshipped the beast and said, who is like to the beast? Who is able to make war with him?
And there was given to him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies, and power was given to him to continue 42 months.
And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and those that live in heaven.
And it was given to him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them, and power was given him over all relatives, and tongues, and nations.
And all that live on the earth will worship him, whose names are not written in the Book of Life of the lamb killed from the foundation of the world.
If a man have an ear, let him hear.
He that leads into captivity will go into captivity, he that kills with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
And I saw another beast coming up out of the earth, and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke as a dragon.
And he exercises all the power of the first beast before him, and causes the earth and them which live in there to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
And he does great wonders, so that he makes fire come down from heaven on the earth in sight of men.

And deceives those that live on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in sight of the beast and said to those that live on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.
And he had power to give life to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.
And he causes all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and slave to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads.
And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
Here is wisdom. Let anyone that has understanding count the number of the beast, because it is the number of a man, and his number is 666.
I looked, and saw the lamb standing on Mount Zion, and there were 140,000 with him, and their father's name was written on their foreheads.
And I heard a voice from heaven, like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of a great thunder, and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps.
And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders, and no man could learn that song but the 144,000, which were rescued from the earth.

These are they which were not defiled with women, because they are virgins. These are they which follow the lamb wherever he goes. These were rescued from among men, being the first fruits to God and to the lamb.
And in their mouth was found no deceit, because they are without fault before the throne of God.
And I saw another angel fly in the middle of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach to those that live on the earth, and to every nation, and relatives, and tongue, and people.
Saying with a loud voice, fear God, and give glory to him, because the hour of his judgment has come, and worship anyone that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
And there followed another angel and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the anger of her fornication.
And the third angel followed them and said with a loud voice, if a man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand.

The same will drink of the wine of the anger of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation, and he will be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the Holy angels, and in the presence of the lamb.
And the smoke of their torment ascends up forever and ever, and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.
Here is the patience of the saints, here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

And I heard a voice from heaven saying to me, write, blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from now on, yes, says the Spirit, that they may rest from their labors, and their works do follow them.
And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and on the cloud one sat like the Son of Man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to anyone that sat on the cloud, thrust in your sickle, and reap, because the time has come for you to reap, because the harvest of the earth is ripe.
And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.

And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire, and cried with a loud cry to anyone that had the sharp sickle and said, thrust in your sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, because her grapes are fully ripe.
And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and threw it into the great winepress of the anger of God.
And the winepress was walked outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress as high like the horse bridles, by the space of a 4,320 cubits.
And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvelous, seven angels having the seven last plagues, because in them is filled up the anger of God.

And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire, and those that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.
And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the lamb and said, great and marvelous are your works, Lord God Almighty, just and true are your ways, you King of saints.
Who will not fear you, O Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are Holy, because all nations will come and worship before you, because your judgments are made obvious.
And after that I looked, and, behold the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
And the seven angels came out of the temple, with seven plagues, clothed in pure white linen, and their breasts were covered with golden belts.
And one of the four beasts gave to the seven angels seven golden vials full of the anger of God, who lives forever and ever.
And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power, and no man was able to enter into the temple, until the seven plagues of the seven angels were satisfied.
And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, go your ways, and pour out the vials of the anger of God on the earth.
And the first went, and poured out his vial on the earth, and there fell a foul smelling and grievous sore on the men which had the mark of the beast, and on them which worshipped his image.
And the second angel poured out his vial on the sea, and it became like the blood of a dead man, and every living soul died in the sea.
And the third angel poured out his vial on the rivers and fountains of waters, and they became blood.
And I heard the angel of the waters say, you are righteous, O Lord, which are, and was, and will be, because you have judged in this.
For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink, because they are worthy.
And I heard another out of the altar say, even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.
And the fourth angel poured out his vial on the sun, and power was given to him to scorch men with fire.
And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which has power over these plagues, and they repented not to give him glory.
And the fifth angel poured out his vial on the seat of the beast, and his kingdom was full of darkness, and they gnawed their tongues for pain.
And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.
And the sixth angel poured out his vial on the great river Euphrates, and the water of it was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.
And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go out to the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watches, and keeps his garments, or else he walk naked, and they see his shame.
And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air, and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne and said, it is done.
And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings, and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were on the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.
And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell, and great Babylon came in remember before God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his anger.
And every island fled, and the mountains had disappeared.
And there fell on men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent, and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, because the plague of it was exceeding great.
And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me and said to me, come here, I will show to you the judgment of the great whore that sits on many waters.
With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.
So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness, and I saw a woman sit on a scarlet colored beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet color, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication.
And on her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF WHORES AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus, and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.
And the angel said to me, because that reason were you astonished? I will tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.

The beast that you saw was, and is not, and will ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition, and they that live on the earth will wonder, whose names were not written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.
A wise mind which is needed here, and the seven heads are seven mountains where the woman sits.
And there are seven Kings, five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come, and when he comes, he must continue a short space.
And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goes into perdition.
And the ten horns which you saw are ten Kings, which have received no kingdom as yet, but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.
These have one mind, and will give their power and strength to the beast.
These will make war with the lamb, and the lamb will overcome them, because he is Lord of lords, and King of Kings, and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.
And he says to me, the waters which you saw, where the whore sits, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.
And the ten horns which you saw on the beast, these will hate the whore, and will make her desolate and naked, and will eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.
For God has put in their hearts to satisfy his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God will be satisfied.
And the woman which you saw is that great city, which reigns over the kings of the earth.
And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power, and the earth was lightened with his glory.

And he cried mightily with a strong voice and said, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the home of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.

For all nations have drunk of the wine of the anger of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are grew rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
And I heard another voice from heaven and said, come out of her, my people, that you do not partake of her sins, and that you receive not of her plagues.
For her sins have reached to heaven, and God has remembered her wickedness.
Reward her even as she rewarded others, and repay her double in accordance with what she has done, and give her a double dose in her own cup.
How much she has glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her, because she says in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will see no sorrow.
And for that reason will her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine, and she will be completely burned with fire, because strong is the Lord God who judges her.
And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, will wail her, and mourn for her, when they will see the smoke of her burning.
Standing far away for the fear of her torment and said, alas, alas that great city Babylon, that mighty city! For in one hour is your judgment come.
And the merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her, because no man bought their merchandise anymore.

The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner bowls of ivory, and all manner bowls of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble.
And cinnamon, and odors, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.
And the fruits that your soul lusted after are left from you, and all things which were dainty and goodly are left from you, and you will find them no more at all.
The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing.
And saying, alas that great city clothed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet decked with gold, pearls, and precious stones!
For in one hour so great riches has come to nothing, and every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood far away.
And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning and said, what city is like to this great city!

And they throw dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing and said, alas, alas that great city, in which were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! For in one hour is she made desolate.
Rejoice over her, you heaven, and you Holy apostles and prophets, because God has avenged you on her.
And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and threw it into the sea and said, in this with violence will that great city Babylon be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.

And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, will be heard no more at all in you, and no craftsman, of whatever craft he be, will be found anymore in you, and the sound of a millstone will be heard no more at all in you.

And the light of a candle will shine no more at all in you, and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you, because your merchants were the great men of the earth, because by your sorceries were all nations deceived.
And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were killed on the earth.
And after these things I heard a great voice of many people in heaven and said, hallelujah, salvation, and glory, and honor, and power, to our Lord God.
For true and righteous are his judgments, because he has judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.
And again they said, hallelujah And her smoke rose up forever and ever.
And the twenty-four elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne and said, amen, hallelujah.
And a voice came out of the throne and said, praise our God, all you his servants, and you that fear him, both small and great.
And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunderings and said, hallelujah, because the Lord God omnipotent reigns.
Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honor to him, because the marriage of the lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.
And it was granted to her to be clothed in fine, clean, white linen, because fine linen is the righteousness of saints.
And he says to me, write, blessed are they which are called to the marriage supper of the lamb, and he says to me, these are the true sayings of God.

And I fell at his feet to worship him, and he said to me, see you do it not, I am your fellow servant, and of your brothers that have the testimony of Jesus, worship God, because the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
And I saw heaven open, and behold a white horse, and he that sat on him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he does judge and make war.
His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns, and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.
And he was dressed in clothes dipped in blood, and The Word of God is his name.
And the armies in heaven followed him on white horses, clothed in fine, clean, white linen.
And out of his mouth goes a sharp sword, that with it he should defeat the nations, and he will rule them with an iron staff, and he walks the winepress of the fierceness and anger of Almighty God.
And he has written on his clothes and his thigh, King of Kings, and Lord of Lords.

And I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he cried with a loud voice and said to all the birds that fly in the middle of heaven, come and gather yourselves together until the supper of the great God.

That you may eat the flesh of Kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of those that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both great and small, free and slave.
And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against anyone that sat on the horse, and against his army.

And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that worked miracles before him, with which he deceived those that had received the mark of the beast, and those that worshipped his image. These both were throw alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.
And the remains were killed with the sword of anyone that sat on the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth, and all the birds were filled with their flesh.
And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years.

And throw him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal on him, that he should deceive the nations no more, until the thousand years should be satisfied, and after that he must be turned loose a little season.

And I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them, and I saw the souls of those that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which did not have worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark on their foreheads, or in their hands, and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
Blessed and Holy is he that has part in the first resurrection, on such the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him a thousand years.
And when the thousand years are expired, satan will be turned loose out of his prison.
And will leave to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, gog, and Magog, to gather them together to battle, the number of whom is like the sand of the sea.
And they went on the width of the earth, and surrounded the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city, and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.
And the devil that deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
And I saw a great white throne, and anyone that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away, and there was found no place for them.

And I saw the dead, great and small and standing before God, and the books were opened and one of them was the Book of Life, and the dead were judged by the things which were written in the books, in accordance with their works.
And the sea gave up its dead, and death and hell delivered the dead within them, and every man was judged in accordance with their works.
And death and hell were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
And whoever was not found written in the Book of Life was thrown into the lake of fire.
And John said "I saw a new heaven and a new earth because the first heaven and earth had passed away, and the seas were gone.
And I John, saw a new Jerusalem the Holy city, brought down from heaven by God, and it had been prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
And I heard a loud voice coming out of heaven that said, 'Behold, God's tabernacle is with people, and God himself will live with them, and they will be his people, and He will be their God.
And God will wipe away all their tear and there will be no more death, crying, sorrow, nor pain, because these things have passed away.
And the one that was sitting on the throne said, 'Behold I am making all things new again. And he said, 'Write this: These words are true and faithful.'
And he said to me, it is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give anyone that thirsts, water from the fountain life.
He that overcomes will inherit all things, and I will be his God, and he will be my son.

But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, will have their part in the lake which burns with fire and brimstone, which is the second death.
And there came to me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me and said, come here, I will show you the bride, the Lamb's wife.
And he carried me in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me that great city of Holy Jerusalem, descending from heaven and God.
Having the glory of God, and her light was like to a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal.
And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written after that, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.
On the east three gates, on the north three gates, on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.
And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the lamb.
And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates of it, and the wall of it.
And the city lies foursquare, and the length is as large like the width, and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the width and the height of it are equal.
He measured the wall and it was 144 cubits long, based on the cubit being length of a man or an angel's forearm.
The wall was built out of jasper, and the city was pure gold, like clear glass.
And the foundations of the wall of the city were decorated with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper, the second, sapphire, the third, a chalcedony, the fourth, an emerald.
The fifth, sardonyx, the sixth, sardius, the seventh, chrysolyte, the eighth, beryl, the ninth, a topaz, the tenth, a chrysoprasus, the eleventh, a jacinth, the twelfth, an amethyst.
And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, every several gate was of one pearl, and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
And I saw no temple in there, because the Lord God Almighty and the lamb are the temple of it.
And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it, because the glory of God did lighten it, and the lamb is the light of it.
And the nations of them which are saved will walk in the light of it, and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honor into it.
And its gates will not be shut at all during the day, because there will be no night there.
And they will bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.
And there will in no way enter into it anything that defiles, neither whatever works abomination, or makes a lie, but they which are written in the Lamb's Book of Life.
Then John wrote, "The angel showed me the pure crystal clear river of the water of life flowing from God's throne and the lamb.

The tree of life which bore twelve kinds of fruit, stood in the middle of the city's street and on both sides of the river. The tree yielded her fruit every month and her leaves were for the healing of the nations.
And there will no longer be a curse, but the throne of God and of the lamb will be in the city and God's servants will serve him.
They will see his face and God's name will be on their minds.
There will be no night there, and they will need no candles nor light from the sun, because the Lord God gives them light and they will reign forever and ever.
Then the angel said to me, 'These things are true and faithful. The Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to show to his servants things which must soon be done.'
And Jesus said, "`For Behold, I will come soon and blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book.´"
And after I John saw and heard these things, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed me these things.
Then the angel said to me, 'Do not do this, for I am a fellow servant along with you and your brothers the prophets, and those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!'
And the angel said to me, 'Do not seal the prophecies written in this book, because the time is here.
Let whoever is unjust continue to be unjust, and let whoever is filthy continue to be filthy, and let whoever is righteous continue to be righteous, and let whoever is holy continue to be holy.'
Then Jesus said to me, '`Behold, soon I will come and bring my reward with me to give to every man according to the works he has done.´
`I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.´
`Blessed are those who keep God's commandments, so that they may have the right to the tree of life, and enter through the gates to the city.´
`Because outside there are dogs, sorcerers, whoremongers, murderers, idolaters, and those who love and tell lies.´
`I Jesus, have sent my angel to testify to you about these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David and the bright morning star.´'
The Spirit and the bride both say, "Come." And let whoever hears this say, "Come." And let whoever is thirsty, come, and let the one who wants to come and drink from the water of life, drink freely.
For I testify to whoever hears the words of prophecy of this book, if anyone adds to these things, God will add the plagues written in this book to him.
And if a man takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will remove his part from the Book of Life, and from the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.'
And Jesus the one who testifies these things says, '`I will surely come soon!´' Amen. Even so, come Lord Jesus.
May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen."
